To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect , redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.

This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.

As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.

Key Responsibilities 

End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization 

- Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.

- Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.

- Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.

- Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).

- Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.

- Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

Data & AI Infrastructure 

- Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.

- Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.

- Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.

- Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture 

- Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.

- Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.

- Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy 

- You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.

- You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.

- Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership 

- Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.

- Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.

- Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.

- Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.

- Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

Who You Are 

- Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.

- Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.

- System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.

- Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.

- Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.

- Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.

- Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

Must-Have Skills & Experience 

- 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.

- Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.

- Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.

- Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.

- Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.

- Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.

- Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).

- Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).

- Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.

- Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.

- Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

Nice-to-Have Skills 

- Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.

- Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.

- Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

Why Join Us? 

- Impact at scale —we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges .

- Modern technical foundation with room to innovate —leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.

- Hands-on architecture leadership —you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.

- Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts , pushing the limits of what’s possible.

- Competitive compensation and high ownership —your work will define how Jumio scales.

Jumio Values: 

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities : 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. title: Backend Software Developer
description:
Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen: 

- Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

- Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

- Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.

- Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

- Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland .

Wat bieden wij jou?

- De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

- Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

- Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

- Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

- Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

- Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

- Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

- Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

- Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

- De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

- Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast .

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 .

Have a great day. Dawn Technology. 

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. 

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Senior Product Builder - Talent Pool
description:

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. About the Role: 

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.

AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up. If you’ve written your own automation, scripts, or internal tooling to remove friction from your own workflow, that’s exactly the instinct we’re hiring for.

Your Impact:

- Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec

- Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end features across the full stack- including a Java/Spring backend, REST APIs, data layer, testing, infrastructure touches, and rollout- while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19, Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.

- Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt

- Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents

- Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line

- Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time

- Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill

Your Qualifications:

- Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19

- A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket

- Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial codebase- this isn’t a greenfield role

- Advanced, hands-on use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow- you’re past the learning curve already

- Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the outcome, good or bad

- Backgrounds we tend to see succeed here: technical founders, early engineers at startups who built the first version, small-company CTOs/Heads of Engineering, or senior engineers with active, recent open-source or side-project work

Our Stack: 

- Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, SQL

- TypeScript, React 19, Redux, Dart

- PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ

- Unit/integration testing, Java web stack

- AI tooling: Cursor, Claude/Codex, Zencoder, internal AI portal, internal MCP

title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote), United States (Remote), United Kingdom (Remote) Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About the Query Team

Every pipeline, job, and test that runs on CircleCI generates data, and that history is one of our biggest advantages in an agentic software delivery lifecycle. Flaky test detection, test insights, pipeline search, and agents that reason about why a build failed all depend on fast, reliable access to it.

The Query team owns the system that makes this possible. We pull product data out of the transactional services that create it and store it in datastores built for historical and analytical workloads. We serve it through domain-level APIs to CircleCI's product teams and to customers through our public API. Our goal is to make storing data "fire and forget" for every other team, and querying it fast and dependable at a scale that keeps growing.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

- Shape how we store data at scale. Own and harden our ClickHouse-based storage layer. Design schemas for known and emerging access patterns, and tune ingestion and query performance to support production-scale data.

- Build the pipelines that move our data. Design and own ingestion from event streams and durable workflows built on Temporal. Data should arrive reliably, stay queryable while it's in transit, and never slow down the critical path of the services that produce it.

- Serve data to the product and to customers. Evolve our platform into the default path for historical queries. Make getting historical data easy, not a bottleneck. Teams should be able to get what they need quickly and with minimal hand-holding, while Query keeps enough visibility into how the data is used to optimize ingestion and reads across every consumer. Build in the indexing, caching, and tiered storage required to keep it performant.

- Set technical direction. When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you lead the design discussion, write up the architecture decision, and make the call. You help decide which data domain we migrate next and how.

- Champion observability. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand ingestion lag, query latency, and data correctness. For a data platform, operational data drives stability, not just incident response.

- Keep things moving. You take ambiguous data problems from design to production quickly, and you help the people around you move faster too.

You don't just patch problems, you ask why they happened. You'll fix the immediate issue, then solve the underlying team practice, process, or system that let it through.

What You'll Bring

- AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.

- Hands-on data experience. You've built or owned data-intensive systems such as ingestion pipelines, event-driven architectures, or analytical and time-series datastores. You understand the tradeoffs between transactional and analytical storage, and you've designed schemas and tuned queries for high-volume workloads. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is a strong plus.

- Backend depth in Go. You're strong in Go, or strong in a comparable language and eager to work in Go: interface design, data modeling, service integration, and concurrency. Familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus, since you'll occasionally work on the product surfaces that display this data.

- Distributed systems judgment. You understand delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery. You know when to rely on a framework's reliability guarantees rather than building your own.

- Technical leadership. You've led the design of complex systems and made tradeoffs deliberately. You leave foundations others can build on. You raise the quality bar through reviews, mentoring, and direct feedback, not just through the code you write.

- A track record of shipping. 5+ years building and operating production backend systems. Your work has served real users, and you've treated latency, reliability, and correctness as design concerns.

Sound like you?

You care about how data powers the product, not just where it lives. You know how to make a datastore fast at scale, and have tuned schemas and queries against real production load. You think like a platform engineer, measuring your work by how much it unblocks the teams building on it. AI isn't a tool you reach for occasionally; it's a core part of how you approach and solve problems. If that sounds like you, we want to talk.

About CircleCI 

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

title: Staff Software Engineer (w/m/d)

Staff Software Engineer. Set the technical direction of an AI-native tax & accounting firm. Own the cross-cutting systems everything else is built on – tax data model, AI correctness, integrations – and multiply the engineering team around you. Work directly with the founders (scaled to millions of users, $100m+ exits).

The opportunity

How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on.

Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business.

The role

As a Staff Software Engineer, you are the technical counterpart to our founders. You look beyond a single product area: you shape the architecture across the platform, make the decisions that are expensive to reverse, and make sure we scale from one country to many without rewriting the core.

You stay hands-on and write a lot of code – but your impact is measured by what the whole engineering team ships.

What you’ll own

- Technical direction: Define architecture and tech strategy across the platform; write and drive RFCs for the decisions that matter.

- Core systems: Own the foundations every product area builds on – the domain model for tax and accounting logic and the integration layer to third-party systems.

- AI correctness at scale: Set the standards for how we build, evaluate and monitor AI pipelines that have to be correct, not just plausible.

- Scale and reliability: Prepare the platform for more countries, more customers and higher compliance demands – security, auditability, observability.

- Engineering bar: Shape how we build – review standards, tooling, delivery practices; mentor senior engineers and own the technical hiring bar.

- Partner to the founders: Translate business strategy into a technical roadmap and spot where technology creates leverage.

Our tech context (greenfield)

- Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates.

- Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, …

- Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines.

- You will decide how this stack evolves as we scale.

What you’ll bring

- 8+ years building and operating production systems, including several years in a technical leadership role (Staff, Lead, Principal or equivalent)

- A track record of designing and evolving the architecture of a product that scaled – in users, data and team size

- Deep backend expertise: data modelling, API design, distributed systems, integrations; strong TypeScript/Node (or the depth to get there fast)

- Influence without authority: you have led technical decisions across team boundaries, with clear written design docs

- Experience making product and business trade-offs together with founders or senior leadership

- You have mentored senior engineers and shaped hiring

- AI deeply integrated into your daily engineering work, plus experience shipping LLM-based features to production

- A degree in computer science or a related field – or an equivalent track record

- Very good English (min. C1); German is a plus

- A valid work permit for Germany and readiness to work on-site in Munich

Nice to have

- Early engineer at a start-up that scaled successfully

- Systems in regulated domains (fintech, accounting, tax, payroll, insurance)

- Multi-country or multi-jurisdiction platforms

- LLM evaluation, RAG or agentic workflows at production scale

What success looks like after 12 months

- Our architecture is ready for the next country without a rewrite.

- Engineers across product areas ship faster because of the foundations and standards you set.

- You are the founders’ go-to partner for every major technical decision.

What you’ll get

- A seat at the table for product and company strategy

- A senior IC path: grow towards Principal – or into engineering leadership, your choice

- The perfect environment to build relevant skills in a world of AI

- Above-market compensation + an equity package with real upside

The process (fast, meaningful, no homework)

- Intro call with a recruiter

- Technical deep-dive with a fellow engineer: walk us through a system you designed (virtually or in person)

- Meet our founding team in a final interview (in person, ~3h, incl. system design and live coding)

We’re building the tax firm of the future. Radically simple. Highly automated. 100% client-focused.

We are rethinking tax advisory from the ground up: simple, fast and transparent – for clients and for our team. Where other firms struggle with manual processes and long waiting times, we build a digital, proactive, AI-powered experience. Repetitive work largely runs by itself, leaving time for advice, special cases and smart solutions.

What sets us apart from other “digital firms”: more than half of our team are software engineers. We build the tools our tax experts use every day – for their real problems, not off the shelf.

We are an experienced team of tax advisors, accountants, digital entrepreneurs and software engineers with an exit track record of €140m, backed by €12m from leading investors. Together with you, we want to build one of Germany’s leading tax firms.

title: Staff Software Engineer, On-Prem
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote) or United States (Remote) or Mexico City, Mexico (Hybrid)

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About the On-Prem Team

The On-Prem team ships CircleCI Server, our self-hosted CI/CD platform for customers who need to run everything inside their own infrastructure: regulated industries, air-gapped environments, and teams with strict data residency and compliance requirements. Our mission is to deliver an on-premises CircleCI that is secure, highly available, and easy to install, upgrade, and support.

Our team serves two kinds of customers: the organizations that run Server, and the CircleCI engineering teams whose services ship inside it. Beyond the product itself, we own the tooling and infrastructure that let those teams package, test, and release their services into Server and keep them current. As a Staff Engineer here, you'll care as much about the internal release experience as about making Server reliable and easy to operate for external customers.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how we approach and solve problems.

- Make shipping into Server easy for every team. Own the platform strategy, setting the technical direction for the tooling, test infrastructure, and release automation that CircleCI teams use to develop and maintain their services inside Server.

- Give customers confidence installing, upgrading, and running CircleCI Server. Customers run Server in environments you'll never see. Make the install experience simpler and more predictable, upgrades safer, and day-to-day operation easier, starting with sensible defaults.

- Own Server's foundation. You'll be responsible for everything from the Kubernetes infrastructure Server deploys into, to the tooling internal teams and customers depend on. That responsibility extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.

- Get operators from symptom to root cause fast. Standardize Server's observability on OpenTelemetry so it works with whatever platform each customer already runs. Build diagnostics that help operators, and the engineers supporting them, find the problem quickly. Partner with Support, Customer Engineering, and customers to find recurring issues and fix them at the source.

- Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.

What You'll Bring

- A platform mindset. You default to building tools, frameworks, and systems that make other engineers more productive rather than solving each problem one-off. You've built internal platforms before and can talk about the leverage they created for the teams that used them.

- AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.

- Deep experience with Kubernetes and Helm. You've designed, deployed, and debugged production systems on Kubernetes. You know where the sharp edges are, especially in customer-operated environments (air-gapped, restricted network, unfamiliar cluster shapes).

- Strong backend and systems foundation. 8+ years building production backend and infrastructure systems, with a history of taking accountability for outcomes. Strong in Go, with real experience in API design, data modelling, distributed systems, and operational tooling.

- System design with business context. You make architecture decisions that span multiple systems and teams, weigh tradeoffs against business needs, and document your reasoning. You're the person others escalate to when the answer isn't obvious.

- Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar across teams through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship.

- Experience with on-premises or self-hosted software. You've shipped software that runs in someone else's environment (enterprise on-prem, self-hosted SaaS, or a distributed system installed by customers), and you understand how that constraint shapes your design choices, release process, and support model.

Sound Like You?

You believe the best platform work makes everyone else faster. You're energized by the challenge of building software that has to work in environments you can't see or control. You want to take a product customers depend on and make it dramatically easier to build, ship, and run, both for them and for the teams whose services live inside it. If that sounds like you, let's talk.

$195,000 — $265,000 CAD 

Expected salary range for San Francisco and the surrounding area.

US SF Bay Area (Metro Zone 3)

$205,000 — $285,000 USD 

Expected salary range for specific metro areas including Boston, Washington DC, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Portland, San Diego, and Seattle. These metro areas may change periodically.

$200,000 — $275,000 USD 

Expected pay range for all other US locations not falling into Metro Zone 3 or Metro Zone 2.

US General

$180,000 — $250,000 USD 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI 

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. 

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring 

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI 

- Job descriptions and messaging : AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

- Application review : For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. 

- Interview notes : With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.

- Outreach : AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment 

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices 

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com . For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role: 

Team's mission 

Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do.

Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it.

Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes.

Your mission 

You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money.

In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed.

What you’ll do: 

- Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services.

- Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space.

- Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together.

- Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant.

- Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention.

- Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping.

What you bring: 

- A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the "why" just as much as the "how" and proactively bring ideas to the table.

- Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up).

- Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript.

- Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client.

- Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.

- A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing.

- True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling.

- A working understanding of event-driven architectures.

- A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints.

- Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets .

- The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority.

It’s great if you have: 

- Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.

- Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users.

- Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation.

- Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).

How we Upvest in you: 

- Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

- Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

- Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

- Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

- Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

- Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

- Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

- Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values: 

- Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

- Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

- Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

- Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

You'll be part of our Mirakl Assistant team, led by Remi Takase, Senior Data Science Manager . The team is part of a passionate and skilled data organisation of Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Data Engineers and SREs, building on a state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Data platform. The Mirakl Assistant team is a new team that runs like a start-up inside a scale-up. Together, you'll be designing, building and scaling the conversational AI assistant that changes how our users work across Mirakl products.

The assistant knows the platform and the users, and helps them get the most out of Mirakl, from finding their way around the product, to understanding their business and growing it. We're taking it from conversational to action-oriented: users ask, and the assistant gets it done.

AI agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software: what customers expect from it, how they interact with it, and how they integrate it into their business. At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.

The position is a permanent contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week.

- Design, build and scale the core capabilities of the Mirakl Assistant, including RAG, LLM orchestration, tool use, memory and context engineering, from rapid prototype to robust production feature

- Own the full production lifecycle of the assistant: automated data pipelines, CI/CD, deployment, load testing, latency and resilience

- Run technical discovery and feasibility studies for new capabilities and integrations across Mirakl products

- Drive quality improvement through rigorous offline and online evaluation, data-driven experimentation and iteration

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Software, Data Engineering, SRE and Product teams to evolve the agentic foundations and translate user needs into capabilities

3. What You'll Bring to the Role 

Experience: 

- 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience

- Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach

- Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design

- Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation

Skills: 

- LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)

- Software engineering proficiency in Python

- Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental

- Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation

- A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production

- Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact 

- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

- Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus

4. Tech Stack 

- Languages: Python, SQL, TypeScript

- Backend: FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL

- Frontend: React (micro-frontend architecture)

- AI: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)

- Data Platform & Orchestration: Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows

- Observability: Langfuse, MLflow

- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP

5. Languages 

- English: Fluent

- French: Fluent

7. Our Hiring Process 

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application - this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

- A 30-minute conversation with one of our Tech Recruiters to discuss your background, expectations, and what Mirakl can offer you

- A 1h10 interview with the Hiring Manager

- A 1-hour STAR interview with future Mirakl colleagues to explore our values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills

- Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.

- Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career

- Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track

You have experience with realtime streaming systems, including concurrency, state management, backpressure, and recovery. You care about data correctness, from timestamps and numeric precision to schema changes and corrections.

- 
You have strong computer science fundamentals and backend engineering skills. Experience in Rust, Go or comparable languages is also valuable.

- 
You turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs and production services, and help other engineers deliver parts of the solution.

- 
You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a distributed team.

- 
Financial or market data experience at a financial institution.

Not required but a plus 

- 
Onchain data experience: blockchain indexing such as with EVM or Solana.

- 
Reference data experience: instrument and entity masters, identifier mapping, effective-dated records, or tokenized asset and fund data.

Experience at a company where the data is the product.

Perks & Benefits

A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

-

A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day

Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺

We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).

Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎

title: Senior Software Engineer, Customs
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Customs Matters More Than Ever 

International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.

That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.

The opportunity: 

Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.

Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.

Things we ❤️ 

- Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way

- Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows

- Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform

- Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases

You will: 

- Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.

- Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.

- Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.

- Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)

- Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.

- Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.

- Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.

- Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.

- Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.

You should have: 

- ≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.

- A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.

- The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.

- A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.

- A desire to develop your tooling repertoire. We are tech-agnostic regarding candidate background, but our platform is built with Ruby.

- Non-optional: an aptitude for learning quickly.

How we work: 

- We come to the office at two to three times a week to hang out, have lunch, white board, and collaborate

- We have the latest and greatest hardware and software for you to work with

- We’re agile, but not married to a single doctrine like scrum. The teams decide how they work best.

- Stack: we’re coming from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith, and moving to React/Typescript, Kotlin Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, GRPC, Postgres, Kafka and Snowflake

What's in it for you? 

- An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a thriving multinational environment 

- Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 

- Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam

- 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.

- Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 

- A defined pension contribution scheme

- Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.

- Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members

- Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

#LI-onsite

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

title: Backend Engineer (Python),AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Canada; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role 

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.

Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do 

- Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.

- Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.

- Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.

- Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.

- Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.

- Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.

- Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.

- Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.

- Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring 

- Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.

- Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.

- Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.

- Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus.

- Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.

- Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team 

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability.

Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups 

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law . If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation , please let us know during the recruiting process .

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gitlab-backend-engineer-python-ai-engineering-agent-foundations

Engineering Lead (m/w/d) - Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände 

80–100 % · Zürich · Festanstellung · per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Über MaxBrain

MaxBrain AG wurde 2016 in der Schweiz gegründet und ist ein führender Anbieter für digitale Lernlösungen mit aktuell 12 Mitarbeitenden. Mit einer innovativen Kombination aus Learning Management System (LMS) und Learning Experience Plattform (LXP) übersetzt MaxBrain Lernstrategien in ganzheitliche, digitale Lern-Ökosysteme für Unternehmen, Bildungszentren und Verbände.

Renommierte Bildungsinstitutionen sowie zukunftsorientierte Unternehmen vertrauen auf die Expertise von MaxBrain, darunter Bildungspartner wie Digicomp, WEKA und Talentus, führende Berufsverbände wie SwissAccounting, Electrosuisse und die OdA beider Basel sowie Marktführer wie Zweifel Chips & Snacks, InfoGuard, BLT Basellandschaft Transport und Baumann Koelliker und viele mehr.

Worum es geht

Als Engineering Lead übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für MaxBrain. Du führst unser Entwicklungsteam über DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile hinweg und bist dabei selbst technisch nah dran – du gibst Architektur, Qualität und Tempo vor. Gemeinsam mit dem CEO und dem Product Lead trägst du die Umsetzungsverantwortung für die Roadmap und stellst sicher, dass die Plattform verlässlich und in hoher Qualität betrieben und weiterentwickelt wird.

Eine zentrale Rolle spielt das Shaping unserer AI-Capabilities: KI ist dabei fest in die ganze Plattform eingebaut, nicht nur in einzelne Funktionen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Kroatien und dem Team in Zürich zusammen, berichtest direkt an den CEO und hast die Perspektive, Teil der Geschäftsleitung zu werden.

Deine Aufgaben

- Technische Führung: Du leitest und entwickelst ein kleines aber erfahrenes Entwicklungsteam von SysAdmin, DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile und schaffst eine Kultur von Ownership, Qualität und Tempo.

- Lieferverantwortung für die Roadmap: In enger Abstimmung mit dem CEO und dem Product Lead sorgst du dafür, dass die Roadmap verlässlich, termingerecht und in hoher Qualität ausgeliefert wird.

- AI-Capabilities weiterentwickeln: Du prägst, wie KI unser Lern Ökosystem spürbar wirksamer macht – ganz im Sinne von «Make Learning Matter». Du führst die KI Transformation in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb der Plattform, um diese neue Technologie gewinnbringend für MaxBrain einzusetzen.

- Technische Projektleitung: Du berätst unsere Kunden und unser Customer Success Team zu Themen wie Integrationen und Automatisierungen und verantwortest entsprechende Projekte von A bis Z aus technischer Sicht.

- Architektur und technische Exzellenz: Du gestaltest die Architektur zusammen mit den Entwicklern, triffst fundierte Technologieentscheidungen und hältst Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit hoch.

- CISO/ISO-27001: Du betreust die jährliche ISO-Rezertifizierung und verantwortest den Bereich Datensicherheit für MaxBrain.

Dein Profil

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung von Entwicklungsteams, idealerweise über DevOps, Frontend, Backend und Mobile hinweg, kombiniert mit eigener technischer Exzellenz.

- Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb skalierbarer B2B-SaaS-Architekturen, inklusive Schnittstellen, Integrationen und Automatisierungen für anspruchsvolle Grosskunden.

- Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen KI-/ML-Technologien und Freude daran, KI-Capabilities von der Idee bis in die Produktion zu bringen.

- Du denkst in Lieferverantwortung: Du priorisiert pragmatisch, triffst klare Architekturentscheidungen und bringst Releases verlässlich und in hoher Qualität auf die Strasse.

- Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt und Business zusammen und übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse in tragfähige technische Lösungen.

- Du bist vertraut mit Symfony/PHP, Go, Angular, MySQL und Docker/Kubernetes. Du findest es spannend, neue Technologien kennenzulernen und verstehst es, sie gewinnbringend einzusetzen.

- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1-C2); unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

- Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direkte Verantwortung für die Entwicklung, Architektur und den Betrieb der SaaS-Plattform.

- Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit dem CEO und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Customer Success und Entwicklung.

title: Cloud Systems Administrator
description:
Headquarters: 

URL: https://oneimaging.com 

Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live. 

What you'll do: 

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first) 

- Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.

- Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.

- Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.

- Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

- Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.

- Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.

- Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

- Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.

- Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

- Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.

- Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.

- Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

- Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.

- Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.

- Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Productivity and email

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Customer support and CRM

Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom

Communications

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Healthcare operations

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

About you: 

- 3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.

- Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.

- Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.

- Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.

- Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.

- Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.

- Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.

Nice to have:

- AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.

- Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.

- MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.

- Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.

The Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Machine Learning Engineering to lead Tala’s ML Platform team. This person will manage a team of Machine Learning Engineers responsible for building the platforms, frameworks, and infrastructure that enable our Data Science teams to securely train, deploy, monitor, and operate machine learning models at scale.

This is a player-coach management role. You’ll be responsible for developing and growing the team while also providing enough technical leadership to guide architecture, engineering practices, reliability, and production systems. - Improve team productivity by reducing context switching and delegating effectively.

- Partner with engineers and technical leads to estimate and scope complex work.

Provide Technical Leadership

- Own and improve SLOs, on-call health, capacity planning, reliability, and incident response.

Partner Across the Organization

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention.
