Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. 

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large or very large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting? 

- Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

- Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

- HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

- Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us? 

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies. 

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects . We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company , challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis , both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀 

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you: 

- Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

- Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English .

- Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills ;

- Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

- Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

- Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

- Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

- Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

- Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. 

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range .

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. 

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits 

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer: 

- Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. 

- Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

- All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

- Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

- Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). 

- Transport . Generous transit benefit

- Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture .

Important note: we hire people, not roles. 

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Trading Infrastructure | Python/Linux
description:
BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam.

Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock.

In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads.

About BlockTech 

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust.

What will you do? 

You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back.

You will: 

- Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one.

- Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on.

- Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk.

- Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves.

- Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments.

- Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does.

- Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark.

- Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start.

What we're looking for 

You'll need: 

- 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role.

- At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders.

- A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter.

- A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike.

- Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level.

- Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture.

- Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar).

- Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services.

- Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD.

- Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana.

- Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure.

Bonus points for: 

- Experience with options or crypto markets.

- Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs).

- Low-latency or market-making environments.

- Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it.

- Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling.

- Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency.

- Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases.

Pay, location, and relocation 

- Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

- Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

- Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

- Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

- Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you 

- Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

- An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

- An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

- Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

- Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

- Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work 

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from the first alert to the long-term fix and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Ready to keep a 24/7 trading firm running? 

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.

Our culture 

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role: 

We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on the financial backbone of Gusto's money movement — the ledger, reconciliation, and reporting systems that account for every dollar, and the payment profile that determines how employers fund payroll and how employees and contractors get paid. As a Gusto Software Engineer at this level, you’ll be guiding projects end-to-end by driving large technical architectural decisions (focusing on scale and modularity), understanding how to take existing systems closer to desired end states, executing on projects, and maintaining code that powers core experiences. If you’re interested in building elegant software with far-reaching effects in our modern economy, join us!

About the Team: 

Financial Data & Payment Profile (FDPP) sits inside Gusto's Payments organization, which moves money safely between partners, employers, employees, government authorities, and Gusto. FDPP owns the two things that every one of those movements depends on.

Financial Data is the system of record for the money itself: the ledger and subledger behind every payment, the reconciliation that proves our books agree with our banks and partners, the investigation of the variances that surface when they do not, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, and Compliance depend on. When Gusto needs to answer where a dollar is — and prove it — the answer comes from systems this team builds.

Payment Profile is what makes a payment possible in the first place: the payment methods available to a customer, the bank accounts and connections behind them, the verification that makes those accounts trustworthy, and the profile state that decides whether a payment can happen at all. Hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on this being right the first time — and on it recovering gracefully when a bank account, a connection, or a preference changes.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day: 

- Design, build, and test the financial data systems that record every dollar Gusto moves — the ledger and subledger that serve as the system of record, the transaction models underneath them, and the financial reporting that Accounting, Finance, Compliance, and our partners rely on to close the books

- Build reconciliation at Gusto's scale: prove that our internal records agree with bank, processor, and partner statements, and make the breaks that fall out of that comparison traceable rather than mysterious

- Lead variance investigation end-to-end — the tooling, instrumentation, and runbooks that turn "the numbers don't tie" into a specific root cause, and then into a fix that eliminates the whole class of break

- Own the payment profile: how employers are set up to fund payroll and how employees and contractors are set up to be paid — the payment methods available and the rules that govern which apply to whom, the bank accounts and connections behind them, and the verification state that determines whether money can move at all

- Make setup and verification something a small business can finish on its own — instant bank verification, graceful handling of broken or revoked connections, and a clear path back to a payable state when something changes

- Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and TypeScript/React applications in the world

- Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Accounting, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams

- Mentor and grow fellow engineers working to create holistic and scalable solutions

Here’s what we're looking for: 

- Successful applicants have at least 10+ years of experience and the enthusiasm for a collaborative, test-driven environment

- Experience building fault-tolerant, mission-critical software as well as designing and developing robust, distributed systems using multiple general-purpose programming languages

- Experience influencing and guiding the work of multiple teams on scaling, refactoring, and optimizing legacy products 

- Experience architecting, building, and testing large-scale production level code that is maintainable, structured, and well-documented

- An aptitude and interest in bringing clarity and simplicity to complex and ambiguous problems

- Ability to communicate technical complexity and help facilitate informed tradeoffs

- Experience in one or more of these domains is strongly preferred: ledger or subledger design, financial reconciliation, accounting systems, or payments infrastructure

- Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts — journal entries, chart of accounts, debits and credits, and tying a subledger out to the general ledger — and the ability to work with accountants and controllers in their own vocabulary

- Experience building systems where correctness, auditability, and immutability matter more than raw throughput, and where a silent data error is worse than an outage

- Bonus: Experience with bank account verification, payment rails (ACH, wire, RTP), or third-party banking data and verification providers

- Bonus: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $183,000-$200,000 /yr in Denver & most remote locations, and $222,000-$245,000 /yr for San Francisco, Seattle & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. 

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto. 

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. title: Product Engineering Lead - Andera
description:
About Andera 

Andera is building reliable AI agents for back-office financial work, starting with automating audits for the world’s largest public companies.

Audits have resisted automation for decades due to the scale and instability of the underlying data. Large companies generate hundreds of millions of tokens of financial data across massive spreadsheets with constantly changing formats. Even understanding a single document can take expert auditors six or more hours , and a typical audit involves many of them.

We’re building agents that can parse, interpret, and reason over data of this complexity—compressing gigabytes of messy financial information into representations that LLMs can work with reliably. The result is turning weeks of manual audit work into minutes of review.

This work requires long-horizon reasoning, robust data systems, and production-grade reliability—and it forms the foundation for automating some of the most complex financial workflows in the world.

Founding Team 

Andera is built on the belief that this problem can only be solved by pairing elite auditors with elite engineers .

- 
Engineering team: Alumni of MIT, Berkeley, and Waterloo, with experience at Jane Street, Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft.

- 
Audit team: Former #1 performers at Deloitte and leaders of national finance practices at Revolut.

The Role 

We’re hiring a Product Engineering Lead to own the primary product experience used by professional auditors. You’ll be responsible for designing and building interfaces that surface large, complex financial datasets and make AI agent output understandable, auditable, and trustworthy.

This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on adoption, trust, and product quality.

What You’ll Work On 

- 
Designing and building intuitive workflows for reviewing complex financial data and AI agent output

- 
Designing and translating Figma designs into polished, production-ready applications

- 
Building a new platform from the ground up, and designing end-to-end features that span frontend, backend, and infrastructure

- 
Working directly with auditors (in house and customers) to understand their workflows and pain points

- 
Improving reliability, performance, and observability across the product

- 
Collaborating closely with AI and systems engineers to integrate agent capabilities into the UI

- 
Building the product team from the ground up

What We’re Looking For 

Strong fullstack engineering skills with ownership mindset

- 
You can design and ship features end to end

- 
You understand how UI, backend, and data systems interact

Deep empathy for users in complex domains 

- 
You can work with auditors to uncover root problems

- 
You can translate ambiguous feedback into clear product decisions

Strong product and design sense 

- 
You know what makes an interface intuitive and trustworthy

- 
You can turn wireframes into clean, usable experiences

Comfort operating in high-complexity systems 

- 
Large datasets, asynchronous workflows, partial failures

Experience with or adjacent to our stack:

- 
TypeScript, Python, Temporal, Docker, Terraform, AWS Fargate

Why Andera 

- 
Own the core product experience from day one

- 
Build software used by some of the largest companies in the world

Work closely with world-class auditors and engineers
High ownership and impact as an early team member

title: Sr. Data Scientist II (Remote Eligible)
description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist II to build the ML models and AI sub-agents that drive growth, monetization, efficiency, and retention across the customer lifecycle. You’ll work end-to-end framing problems, building models across the modern ML and deep learning toolkit, designing sub-agents that reason and act, and shipping all of it into production for millions of users. The data is unusually rich: petabyte-scale execution data spanning two decades of how real work gets done. You are curious, technically rigorous, and can translate complex modeling and sub-agent behavior into clear recommendations for your partners. You will work primarily with Product and Engineering and will be a part of Smartsheet’s Business Intelligence team.

This full-time position will report to a Data Science & BI Leader and can be located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will: 

- Design and ship AI sub-agents that act across the customer lifecycle, combining predictive models, retrieved context, and LLM reasoning to recommend or take action

- Build the predictive and prescriptive models that power those sub-agents churn risk, growth, adoption trajectories, account health scoring, and similar lifecycle problems

- Develop the data foundations and knowledge layer those sub-agents reason over, applying responsible aggregation and privacy-aware design

- Design the tools, retrieval, and grounding strategies each sub-agent uses; decide when a sub-agent should act, recommend, defer, or escalate

- Build the evaluation harnesses that determine when a sub-agent is good enough to ship and that catch regressions in production

- Define metrics and experimentation strategy for sub-agent rollouts; measure real customer impact, not just offline accuracy or eval scores

- Partner with Product, Engineering, and Applied AI teams from problem framing through production deployment

- Drive a data and modeling culture within Product and Engineering, and mentor other data scientists on the team

- Understand our customer needs and design metrics to analyze how our customers are using product and optimize products and features

- Conduct experiments, causal studies and A/B tests to measure the impact of product changes

You Have: 

- Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience (or 10+ years of experience); advanced degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, CS, ML, Economics, Operations Research, or similar) preferred

- Deep applied ML expertise across both traditional ML and deep learning: gradient boosting, regularized linear models, transformer-based sequence models, foundation model embeddings, causal ML, contextual bandits, and offline RL

- Strong grasp of causal inference for intervention design and lifecycle modeling: uplift modeling, difference-in-differences, propensity scoring, and synthetic control

- Solid foundation in statistics and experimental design: hypothesis testing, power analysis, multiple comparisons, sequential testing, and quasi-experimental methods

- Hands-on experience taking LLM- and agent-based systems to production: tool use, retrieval, multi-step reasoning, evaluation, and guardrails

- Experience operating ML in production — feature engineering and pipelines, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining cadence, and the trade-offs between batch and real-time serving

- Proficient in SQL and Python; comfort with ML/LLM tooling at scale (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), ML frameworks (PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM), and visualization tools (Tableau or similar)

- Experience modeling the customer lifecycle — churn, expansion, adoption, plan health, lead/account scoring — and business fluency in the SaaS metrics that drive it (NRR, GRR, ARR, and cohort economics)

- A pragmatic production bar: latency, cost, monitoring, drift, hallucination, and what happens when the model or sub-agent is wrong

- Strong track record of forming effective cross-functional partnerships and communicating analysis clearly to technical and executive audiences

- Ability to research and learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies, and to thrive in a dynamic environment — finding opportunities and executing in both independent and collaborative environments

- 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

- Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

title: Billing Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (United States)

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role 

We’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

- Deliver projects related to pricing plans and billing 

- Develop our billing integration with third party services, strengthening our end-to-end billing experience.

- Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making.

- Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities 

- Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core billing software components.

- Integrate with third-party billing platforms (e.g., Stripe, Metronome) as needed

- Develop metering, pricing, and rating logic for usage-based and subscription billing models.

- Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of customer usage data.

- Monitor and maintain billing systems to ensure high availability and data integrity.

- Build automation tools for recurring billing tasks, reconciliation, and reporting.

- Collaborate with product, sales, and finance teams to support custom billing requirements.

- Work closely with finance, product, support, and engineering teams to support accurate billing, revenue reporting, and customer inquiries.

- Act as a technical expert in billing-related discussions and planning.

- Champion engineering excellence by driving code quality, architectural reviews, and design documentation.

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, fostering a culture of learning and knowledge sharing.

- Establish observability, alerting, and error handling across the billing pipeline to ensure high availability and responsiveness.

- Lead incident response and root cause analysis for billing-related issues.

What We Are Looking For 

- Experience in backend software engineering, with a strong focus on billing, payments, or financial systems.

- Deep knowledge of SaaS billing models, including subscriptions, usage-based pricing, proration, discounts, and entitlements.

- Proven experience integrating with third-party billing platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, Orb, Zuora, etc, or building custom billing systems.

- Experience designing and managing distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

- Proficient with SQL and data modeling, especially for financial and usage data.

- Solid understanding of APIs and experience building or integrating internal billing APIs.

- Strong proficiency in Go, or comfortable writing production-quality code in another language and eager to work with Go

title: Staff Cryptography Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1919 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities :

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

- Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS

- Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills

- Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.

title: Full-Stack Growth Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Growth Engineer to build and maintain the product and systems that help more of the right people discover Future, convert into members, and reach their first moments of value.

You’ll work across web and backend surfaces that power acquisition, signup and access, onboarding and activation, and early engagement. You’ll ship experiments end to end, instrument funnels carefully, and partner closely with product, design, data, and marketing on a small, senior team.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product judgment and system design, write production code, run trustworthy experiments, and turn learnings into durable product improvements — not one-off hacks.

What You’ll Own:

- Acquisition and Conversion: Build and improve the web and product surfaces that introduce Future to prospective members and turn interest into signup. These include landing experiences, checkout and plan selection flows, and the instrumentation that shows where people drop off.

- Access and Onboarding: Simplify signup, login, account creation, and first-session activation. Remove friction, clarify value on Day 1, and help new members connect with coaching and get started quickly.

- Experimentation Systems: Design, ship, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across the funnel. Partner with data to define metrics, guardrails, and experiment hygiene so we learn fast without polluting the product.

- Full-Stack Delivery : Implement features across frontend and backend — APIs, services, web UI, and the glue between growth surfaces and the core member product. Prefer clear ownership and fast iteration over brittle one-off paths.

- Measurement and Insight: Instrument funnels, cohorts, and activation milestones. Use qualitative and quantitative signal to find leverage, prioritize work, and explain why experiments won or lost.

- Reliability for Growth Paths: Keep high-traffic growth journeys fast, stable, and observable. Treat conversion-critical paths with the same engineering care as core product.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work tightly with product, design, data, and marketing. Translate growth hypotheses into shippable product work and bring engineering judgment into roadmap tradeoffs.

- AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members or prospects.

Who You Are:

Experience and Background

- You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer growth, acquisition, activation, or conversion surfaces.

- You are strong full-stack: comfortable across modern web frontend and backend services, and able to ship an experiment from UI through API and data without waiting on another team for every layer.

- You have run growth experiments in production — A/B tests, funnel instrumentation, and iteration based on measured outcomes, not vibes alone.

- You understand customer journeys: segments, touchpoints, dropoff analysis, and how product changes move activation and retention metrics.

- You can debug across web UI, networking, backend services, analytics pipelines, and CI.

- You have partnered with product, design, and data (or marketing) to take ambiguous growth problems from hypothesis to shipped learning.

- You write clear, maintainable code and care about experiment integrity, observability, and long-term operability — not just shipping the next test.

- You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.

Domain Passion

You care about health, fitness, and helping people start — and stick with — better habits. You’re motivated by the craft of turning curiosity into membership and first value.

Working Style

- You bias to action, then measure. You ship small, learn, and compound.

- You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions when experiments or funnels look wrong.

- You share context, invite feedback, and keep partners aligned on metrics and tradeoffs.

- You take ownership from discovery through production support on the paths you ship.

- You balance growth urgency with product quality and member trust.

Nice to Have 

- Experience at a consumer subscription, marketplace, or membership product where acquisition and activation were core to the business.

- Familiarity with HIPAA and other laws and regulations that apply to health products and services.

- Experience with paid acquisition landing systems, attribution, SEO/organic surfaces, lifecycle messaging, or referral loops.

- Experience building or evolving experimentation platforms, feature flags, or analytics instrumentation at scale.

- Experience with fitness, health, coaching, or other personalized consumer products.

- Prior work on expert tooling, internal operator workflows, or coach-facing surfaces that support member outcomes.

Compensation, Benefits & Life at Future: 

- Salary range: $200,000 - 230,000 / year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. 

- Health coverage: All employees have access to comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance + tax savings accounts 

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible Paid Time Off

- Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free! 

- Health, Wellness & Development: Health and fitness monthly stipend contributes to our employees’ overall wellbeing, with access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend. 

- Remote First: Employment eligible to employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required. 

- Join a diverse, passionate & driven team of all backgrounds.

Life at Future 

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Future 

We are committed to building a future where every member of our community, is healthy, cared for, and advancing forward together. Future is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age, civil or family status, disability or race.

Youâll work across sales, marketing, partner and customer success rather than owning a single domain, and youâll deliver models as analysis and scored datasets that feed the teamâs reporting and AI tools.

What Youâll Do 

- Build statistical models for go-to-market questions, such as account propensity across product families, renewal and churn risk, stage-to-stage pipeline conversion, and time to close.

- Build pipeline and bookings forecasts with intervals that show how far the forecast could miss.

- Measure impact where randomized tests arenât possible, using matched control groups, cohort comparisons and difference-in-differences, and say plainly what the data can and canât support.

- Deliver model outputs as scheduled, scored datasets in dbt and Databricks so they feed dashboards and AI skills, following Data Engineeringâs standards.

- Review the teamâs analyses for statistical soundness, including sample size, selection effects and multiple comparisons, and teach those methods to other analysts.

- Translate results into recommendations leaders can act on, and present them.

What Youâll Bring 

- 4â7 years in analytics, with substantial work on statistical modelling or forecasting.

- Applied statistics: linear and logistic regression, time series, hypothesis testing, and causal inference fundamentals.

- Strong Python (pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and expert SQL.

- Experience shipping a model that was used repeatedly, not just presented once.

- The ability to explain a modelâs assumptions and limits to non-technical audiences.

Nice To Have 

- Experience with dbt and Databricks

- Experience with B2B SaaS go-to-market data, especially Salesforce

Better Together 

Diversity. Inclusion. Theyâre more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers whoÂ come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us 

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilegeâ¢. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com .Â

title: IT Systems Automation Engineer (f/m/x)
description:
bonial helps you save time, money and paper! 

We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail? 

bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms " kaufDA " and " MeinProspekt " in Germany, and “ Bonial ” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.
We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you. 

bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers! 

About The Role 

IT Operations keeps the company's core productivity, identity, and device ecosystem running smoothly and securely. As IT Systems Automation Engineer, you will own the design, implementation, and maintenance of automation across our corporate IT platforms (including M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune, Atlassian & Slack). You'll reduce manual work for the team, improve consistency and security across the employee lifecycle. You’ll help build the scripts, integrations, and workflows that let a 6-person team support the whole organization efficiently. This is a hands-on engineering role within IT Operations, not a helpdesk position - you'll spend most of your time building and improving systems rather than handling day-to-day tickets. 

What You’ll Do 

- Automate the employee lifecycle: Design and maintain automated workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and role changes across M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Intune, and Slack (provisioning/deprovisioning accounts, licenses, group memberships, and device enrollment) 

- Device management: Build and maintain JAMF (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows/mobile) configuration profiles, compliance policies, and automated patch/update workflows. 

- Identity & access automation: Automate group and license assignment, conditional access rules, and access reviews across M365 and Google Workspace, working closely with the security team where relevant. 

- Collaboration tooling: Manage and automate Slack workspace administration - channel provisioning, app/integration approvals, user lifecycle, and usage policies. 

- Scripting & integration: Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Google Apps Script, or similar) and use APIs to connect systems that don't natively integrate. 

- Documentation & runbooks: Document automation logic, workflows, and recovery procedures so the rest of the team can support and extend what you build. 

- Monitoring & reliability: Set up monitoring/alerting for automated workflows so failures (e.g., a broken onboarding script) are caught and resolved quickly. 

- Continuous improvement: Identify manual, repetitive IT Operations tasks and propose/build automation to eliminate them. 

- Vendor & tooling evaluation: Assess new automation tools or platform features (e.g., new Intune or JAMF capabilities) and recommend adoption where it adds value. 

- Agentic support: Design, build, and operate AI agents that resolve common IT support requests end-to-end (e.g., password resets, access and software requests, device troubleshooting) via Slack or the service desk, connecting them to M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, and Intune through APIs, with clear guardrails, approval steps, human escalation paths, and audit logging. 

- AI enablement: Roll out and administer AI tools across the organization (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude AI/Code, or similar), including license assignment, data access and governance settings, and usage policies, working closely with security, legal, and the works council where relevant, and support employees with onboarding guides, training materials, and best practices. 

What We’re Looking For 

- Required: 

• Experience in IT Operations, Systems Administration, or a similar role with hands-on scripting/automation responsibility. 

• Practical experience administering at least two of: Microsoft 365 (Entra ID/Exchange/SharePoint admin), Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune. 

• Working proficiency in at least one scripting/automation language (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Google Apps Script) and comfort using REST APIs. 

• Understanding of core identity and device management concepts: SSO, MDM/UEM, conditional access, device compliance. 

• Ability to document processes clearly for a small team that needs to maintain what you build. 

- Nice to Have: 

• Experience with Slack administration or Slack API/workflow automation. 

• Experience with a scripting/orchestration platform (e.g., Workato, Tines, Zapier, Azure Automation, or similar iPaaS tools). 

• Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft MS-102/MD-102, Jamf Certified Admin, Google Workspace Administrator). 

• Familiarity with security/compliance frameworks relevant to endpoint and identity management (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001). 

• Experience working on a small IT team where you own end-to-end delivery rather than a narrow slice of a larger org. 

What We Offer: 

High growth story - bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. We are a leading player and a driving force in an industry that is undergoing a massive and a once-in-a-lifetime shift from print to digital. 

Innovation & tech - we are a high-tech company focused on innovative technology, leveraging AI and other tools to maximize productivity and efficiency. We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users. 

Exciting environment for professional development - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities. 

Diversity - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and to being a safe space regardless of race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender, gender identity or gender expression. 

Wellbeing - we believe mental health is as important as being fit. That's why we're giving you free access to nilo.health, a mental health app. In terms of physical training, other than our awesome gym in the office, we also cover part of the subscription to the Urban Sports Club. We can also offer you a corporate pension scheme so you don't have to worry about your retirement. 

Sustainability - together with our Green team, we offer you the opportunity to engage in projects that promote sustainability, environmental development and the impact that we make on our planet. 

Flexibility - Currently, we have a policy that allows for up to 20% mobile work, which can be conducted from anywhere within Germany, and the option to work from abroad. Additionally, we offer 28 days of holiday. You also get an extra day for each calendar year (up to 30 days) as well as other occasions (moving, working on a social project, etc).* 

Modern office - Zen Rooms where employees can pray, relax or simply have some quiet time; fully equipped gym in the office, and a roof terrace for amazing social events. 

Free lunch – whenever you’re at the office, we offer you different lunch options – and it’s all on us! Enjoy your lunch at a nearby restaurant that partners with us! Hot and cold drinks, fruit, regular varied and healthy breakfasts and other snacks at the office are, of course, always available for free for our employees.* 

Social Culture – which encourages people to start conversations, build relationships and participate together in the community through regular team events. 

Partner for retail - we empower retailers to reach their customers in the most efficient and effective way possible. We see ourselves as a critical business partner for retail, and as highlighted in our Company Vision, we “Enrich local shopping for everyone. Everyday.” 

As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials . 

If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you! 

You can check out our bonial_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium . 

*as per our current Works Agreements

title: Manager, Product Design
description:
About Carrot: 

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com .

The Opportunity ð 

Carrotâs User Experience team is seeking a Manager, Product Design to lead a team of senior product designers building our member-facing products. Youâll lead project work, raise the craft bar through direct feedback, and help our design function evolve as AI tools reshape the boundaries between design, product management, and engineering. Youâll partner with Content Design, Product Management, and Engineering leaders to deliver products that scale our impact to members worldwide.

This is a true player-coach role: roughly half your time goes to hands-on design work, including design system and foundational direction, and half to leading and coaching the team. If you love sharpening experienced designersâ work, designing for a diverse set of member needs across all paths to parenthood, and shaping how a design team works in an AI-enabled future, this role is for you.

Â 

What Youâll OwnÂ ð¼ 

In this role, you will:

- Lead design initiatives from strategy to launch, ensuring work meets project goals, timelines, and business priorities.

- Give clear, actionable craft feedback through critiques and design reviews, holding a high bar for quality, consistency, and accessibility.

- Contribute hands-on design, prototypes, or direction on complex, high-visibility initiatives, including design system and foundational work.

- Coach designers to plan and run their own research, from study design through synthesis, and ensure qualitative and quantitative evidence shapes design decisions.

- Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on goals, scope, and delivery, and communicate the teamâs results and design rationale to senior stakeholders.

- Drive adoption of AI tools that help designers work faster, more consistently, and with greater capacity, and evaluate what works.

- Help redefine how design works with product and engineering as role boundaries shift, and recommend process changes to the product development lifecycle.

- Hold regular 1:1s and coach designers on craft, influence, and career growth, tied to Carrotâs leveling framework.

- Own performance management, including goal-setting, reviews, and calibration input, and address gaps directly and fairly.

- Build an inclusive, psychologically safe culture where designers feel ownership of their work.

Â 

What Success Looks Like Â ð 

In your first 12â18 months, you will have:

- Delivered design work on high-visibility initiatives that met project goals, timelines, and business priorities.

- Established a critique and design review rhythm that has visibly raised the quality, consistency, and accessibility of what the team ships.

- Introduced AI tools and practices that improved the teamâs speed, consistency, or capacity, and helped clarify how design works with product and engineering as roles shift.

- Built a research practice in which designers plan and run their own studies, and evidence shapes design decisions.

- Coached each designer with clear goals, regular feedback, and a development path tied to Carrotâs leveling framework, and built a team culture where designers feel ownership of their work.

Â 

About You â¨ 

You likely have:

- A Bachelorâs degree

- 10+ years in product design or UX/UI, including 2+ years managing designers.

- A portfolio of shipped, user-centered, member- or consumer-facing digital products, with evidence of leading a teamâs output.

- A track record of coaching experienced designers, giving direct craft feedback, and handling performance conversations.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to prototype and ship design work, and helping a team adapt its practices as roles evolve.

- Experience evolving a design system in collaboration with engineers, ideally across multiple products.

- Strong knowledge of interaction design, visual design, WCAG accessibility, and responsive and mobile design.

- Experience planning and running user research, from interviews and usability testing to quantitative analysis, and coaching designers to do the same.

- Excellent communication skills, including influencing senior stakeholders and articulating design rationale.

- Comfort with ambiguity and change in a fast-paced agile environment, with clear trade-off decisions.

Â 

Nice to Have â­ 

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

- Experience designing configuration-driven products, where rules and settings (such as eligibility or plan rules) determine what each person sees.

- Familiarity with the healthcare industry, insurance, finance, and compliance, alongside sensitivity to the challenges of fertility health and family forming around the world.

- Familiarity with front-end development principles (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to collaborate effectively with engineers.

- Experience managing distributed or global teams across time zones.

- Demonstrated track record with strategic headcount allocation, resource budgeting, and external partner management.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡ 

Carrotâs members come to us at some of the most personal and consequential moments of their lives, across every path to parenthood and lifelong fertility healthcare. The quality of our design shapes whether they feel understood, supported, and able to get the care they need.

At the same time, the way design teams work is changing quickly. Youâll help define how a senior team adopts AI tools, how design works alongside product and engineering as role boundaries shift, and what great craft looks like in that environment, while staying close to the work yourself.

Â 

Interview Process ð¤ 

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

- Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes

- Hiring Manager Interview â 30 minutes

- Portfolio Review Interviewâ 60 minutes

- Executive Leadership Conversation â 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð 

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

- A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

- A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

- Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

- Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

- Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

- A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

- The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Â 

Compensation ð° 

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package.Â Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrotâs long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

- Base Salary Range: $162,000- $190,000

- Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $200,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Â 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com 

Â 

A Note on AI 

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirementâand we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot? 

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcareâs Innovators. Carrotâs global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortuneâs Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.Â 

Â

title: Manager, Software Engineering, Operations
description:
Want to lead engineers building software that helps pros get the job done and know exactly how their business is doing? 

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Manager, Software Engineering to be part of our SP (Service Provider) Operations group, focused on helping Service Providers run their day-to-day operations efficiently and effectively.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .

We help employees grow professionally; we have a ton of onboarding resources, tutorials, hackathons and buddies to support learnings and provide opportunities to innovate. We have a range of experience levels on teams which allows for mentor/mentee opportunities. Leaders at Jobber work with empathy and support employees to build healthy work-life harmony. Bring your dedication and passion to this job to fulfill your goals.

The team: 

In this role, you will manage the engineering teams behind one of Jobber's most important domains, Jobs Teams, as part of the greater SP Operations Group. The Jobs Team is at the heart of how service businesses operate, and we are constantly improving how service providers orchestrate work from start to finish so they can confidently deliver every job with quality. You will work alongside peers from Product Management, Design, and the rest of the Engineering Leadership team to ensure the tools we build help small businesses run more efficiently and grow with confidence!

The role: 

As a leader within the SP Operations group, you will manage the engineering teams to deliver high quality, on time while they get to grow and learn along the way. The SP Operations group's mission is to help Service Providers run their businesses as efficiently as possible. We build the tools that help with day-to-day operations, from scheduling and managing work and crew to ensure every job gets done, to giving business owners the visibility they need to understand their business health and make informed decisions.

Reporting to a Senior Manager of Software Engineering, the Manager of Software Engineering will lead and support their team members in developing their skills and advancing their careers—all while contributing to our mission of empowering small businesses. You'll also play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our platform, ensuring it remains reliable and high-performing as we scale Jobber.

The Manager, Software Engineering will: 

- 
Live and breathe performance facilitation. You want to work with your team(s) to help them master their individual crafts, while also collaborating to build extraordinary experiences and systems.

- 
Be committed to the success of your people. You will help them set goals, have regular 1-on-1s, and provide constructive feedback and coaching to ensure your team's success. You’ll work to understand employees’ career direction and work to empower their journey by acting as a mentor and coach.

- 
Develop a world-class team alongside a world-class organization. You’ll participate in recruiting events and the hiring process while also working to level up your internal team while implementing new processes, all to develop a world-class engineering department.

- 
Remove roadblocks and build guardrails. You’ll work with the other leaders to create and maintain an environment where people can rapidly produce top-quality work that ultimately helps our customers be successful.

- 
Collaborate with other stakeholders across the business. Whether it’s our Management teams within Product, or our Business Technology teams, you’re working closely with other Jobberinos to find the best solutions in Jobber for small businesses.

To be successful, you should have: 

- 
A track record of success in being an established software engineer, as well as time spent in a leadership position, guiding a team in the delivery of quality software.

- 
Strong full-stack technical background, including design and architectural experience. 

- 
A drive to succeed and deliver impactful projects on time. For a high performing team with a solid roadmap that might look like getting out of their way, but for a team whose delivery is in doubt, it means getting in and getting dirty, and working with the team to find a path back to success.

- 
The ability to be agile in an agile environment. You’ll need to be able to lead and teach your team to adapt to change, while also thinking critically and creatively to find answers to problems.

- 
Effective written and oral communication. Being transparent with your team and establishing an open dialogue will be a key to success in supporting your coaching conversations and discussions.

- 
To be a leader and mentor. You’ll bring your shared experience into conversations to influence and provide constructive feedback to direct reports throughout the journey to ensure goals are being met and exceeded.

- 
Familiarity or comfort in AI tools and AI augmented development rhythms.

Highly desired, but not a dealbreaker: 

- 
Previous experience with our development stack: ReactJS, Typescript, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL.

- 
Previous experience with building zero to one projects from initial discovery and design, through implementation, and into delivery and measurement.

Location: 

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation: 

At Jobber, we also believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $169,200 CAD, a midpoint of $199,100 CAD , and a maximum salary of $228,900 CAD, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!
