title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Canada (EST) OR Remote, US (EST) OR Remote, UK

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About Delivery Engineering

Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil.

Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on.

We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

- Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents. Help define the end-to-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on.

- Start from how our teams actually work. Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate.

- Build platforms, not one-offs. Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done.

- Measure what matters. Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns.

- Make build-vs-buy calls. Evaluate models, vendors, and open-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage.

- Lead through influence. Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows.

What You'll Bring

- Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts. You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work.

- Hands-on depth with agentic tooling. You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics.

- A platform mindset. You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption.

- Backend depth in Go. You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration.

- A track record at staff scope. 8+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed.

- Decision-making grounded in your users. You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone.

Sound like you?

You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

Canada Base Pay Range

$195,000 — $265,000 CAD 

United Kingdom Base Pay Range

£125,000 — £170,000 GBP 

Expected salary range for specific metro areas including Boston, Washington DC, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Portland, San Diego, and Seattle. These metro areas may change periodically.

US Metro Zone 2

$200,000 — $275,000 USD 

Expected pay range for all other US locations not falling into Metro Zone 3 or Metro Zone 2.

US General

$180,000 — $250,000 USD

About CircleCI 

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. 

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring 

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI 

- Job descriptions and messaging : AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

- Application review : For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. 

- Interview notes : With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.

- Outreach : AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment 

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices 

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com . For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

- You're 5+ years active as a Fullstack Developer/ Software Engineer.

- You are eager to get started, but always want to know the why. 

- Furthermore, we find it important that you can teach us something and can enthusiastically tell us about other projects you've done. 

- A big advantage would be if you have experience with: .NET CORE, Azure and StoryBook.

- A salary between €5000 and €7200 gross per month (excluding vacation pay and annual bonus) 

- A premium free-of-contribution pensionplan, 30 vacation days, travel allowance and a home office and internet allowance. 

- Flexibility in working hours, and the possibility to work 50% from home (and even several weeks a year from abroad). 

- Lots of room to grow and develop - through our Independer-wide training offer or on an individual level. 

- Fun events, drinks and various (bi-)weekly sports activities. 

- An extensive, fresh and healthy lunch in our company bakery every day. 

- A nice office -with free parking- full of enthusiastic colleagues, at the edge of the Hilversum Mediapark.

title: AI Systems Engineer
description:
Who is Sonar? 

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 

Position description 

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.

What you will do 

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in: 

- 
AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

- 
ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

- 
Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

- 
Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

- 
Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

- 
CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

- 
ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

- 
Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

- 
Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

- 
Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead

Experience and qualifications 

Experience & Technical Acumen 

- 
AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

- 
Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

- 
Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

- 
Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

- 
CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

- 
ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

- 
Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

- 
Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

Leadership & Soft Skills 

- 
Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

- 
Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

- 
Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

- 
Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

- 
Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

- 
Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

- 
Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

- 
Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

In-office culture 

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
. 

See yourself at Twilio 

Join the team as Twilio’s next Architect on our Data Substrate team

About the job 

Twilio runs on data, and the platform underneath it is entering a major shift. Open table formats, the convergence of lakes and warehouses, tightening privacy regulation, and AI workloads are all changing what a data platform has to do. We’re hiring an Architect to set our direction through that shift and to make sure the systems we build over the next 3-5 years are the right ones.

You’ll own the technical strategy for our data platform, spanning storage, lake and lakehouse architecture, catalog and governance, and privacy-by-design. You’ll work across org boundaries, setting standards that dozens of teams build on and raising the technical bar for the engineers around you.

Responsibilities 

In this role, you’ll:

- Own the architecture and multi-year technical strategy for the data platform, including the lake/lakehouse, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and governance, and keep them coherent as one platform rather than separate systems. Define where each engine fits (for example, ClickHouse versus open table formats on object storage) and the migration path between them.

- Make and document the major design decisions (ADRs, RFCs) on storage and open table formats, catalog strategy, compute engines, tenancy, data placement, and build-versus-adopt tradeoffs, with cost and performance at petabyte scale as explicit design constraints.

- Set the reference architectures for how our core storage and query engines (ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and lake engines) are deployed, tuned, scaled and operated as shared platforms, including capacity, cost, tenant isolation, and upgrade strategy.

- Define the reliability model for the platform: availability targets, failure domains, disaster recovery, observability, and incident response patterns that teams can adopt.

- Build privacy and compliance into the architecture, not onto it. Design deletion and right-to-erasure, retention, data residency, and PII classification so they work across the platform’s storage layers, backups, and derived datasets, including data that arrives from upstream streaming systems.

- Drive data governance: classification, catalog and metadata, lineage, access control integrated with our authentication and authorization systems, data contracts, quality and integrity standards, and a catalog teams actually use.

- Review designs and technical direction across the org, and act as the escalation point on hard distributed-systems and performance problems.

- Mentor principal and senior engineers, and grow architectural judgment across the org, not only within one squad.

- Partner with product, security, infrastructure and consuming teams to turn business needs into platform roadmaps, and say no or re-sequence when the tradeoffs require it.

- Track emerging data technologies (such as streaming-first architectures, federated query, and AI-ready data layers) and bring forward the ones worth adopting, with evidence from prototypes or benchmarks.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required: 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 15+ years of experience in software development or a related field, with at least 8 years in an architecture or senior technical leadership role.

- Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale data platforms and setting their technical strategy, on cloud infrastructure such as AWS, deployed with Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm.

- Deep expertise in storage and compute for analytical data: columnar and open table formats, lake and lakehouse architecture, partitioning, indexing, query planning, and how the choices affect cost and performance at petabyte scale.

- Breadth across data storage and retrieval technologies, with hands-on depth in at least two of: analytical/OLAP engines (e.g., ClickHouse), search engines (e.g., ElasticSearch/OpenSearch), and lake or distributed processing engines (e.g., Spark, Trino, Flink). You can reason about when to use each, how they interoperate, and how to migrate between them.

- Working knowledge of streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) and how they interact with downstream storage.

- Practical experience designing data governance at scale: data classification, catalog and metadata management, lineage, and access control integrated with authentication and authorization systems.

- Practical experience implementing privacy and compliance requirements (deletion, retention, residency) across a large, heterogeneous data estate.

- Proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, and Go.

- Track record of writing and driving architecture decisions across multiple teams, and of changing the direction of an organization’s technical roadmap through influence rather than authority.

- Experience elevating engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers across teams.

- Demonstrated commitment to operational excellence: architecting for high availability, observability and incident response in distributed systems, and being credible when a platform is failing in production.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including making a complex tradeoff clear to engineers and to senior leadership.

Desired: 

- Experience operating one of these engines (e.g., ClickHouse, ElasticSearch) at scale, including replication, sharding, ingestion behavior, and multi-tenant isolation.

- Experience with catalog and metadata systems (e.g., Unity Catalog, Glue, Polaris, DataHub) and open table format catalog strategy.

- Experience with a platform migration across domains or ownership models, such as moving from central to domain-owned data.

- A track record of measurable cost optimization on large data platforms.

- Networking and network security knowledge.

Location 

This role will be remote, and based in the United States. 

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer 

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location 

Compensation 

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only. 

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

- Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $211,920 - $264,900. 

- Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $224,400 - $280,500.

- Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $249,360 - $311,700.

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information 

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 1/4/2027 but may change based on business needs. 

. 

Twilio thinks big. Do you? 

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud 

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. title: AI/ML Engineer - Production AI & LLM Systems (India)
description:
Headquarters: India

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/vBHEuzwk8ghJwdk43HHAzt/jobs-at-volga-partners 

AI Engineer | India 

Department: Engineering 
Reports To: Product & Engineering Leadership 
Location: India - Fully Remote 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Level: Mid-Level 
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 

Position Overview 

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

Key Responsibilities 

AI System Development 

- Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions. 
- Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity. 
- Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation. 
- Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption. 
- Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations. 
Production & Optimization 

- Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost. 
- Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch. 
- Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users. 
Collaboration

- Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications. 
- Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making. 
- Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions. 
Research & Experimentation 

- Read and evaluate ML research papers. 
- Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable. 
- Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems. 
- Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives. 

Working Relationships 

The AI Engineer will collaborate with: 

- Engineering leadership and product teams. 
- Software engineers and backend developers. 
- Global AI research and development teams. 

Success in This Role 

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. 

You should be able to: 

- Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact. 
- Translate research into practical engineering solutions. 
- Collaborate effectively across distributed teams. 
- Document and share technical knowledge for scalability. 
- Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities. 

Work Environment 

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 

Required Work Schedule 

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

Our Hiring Process 

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 

1. Initial Recruiter Screening 

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners. 

2. Practical Skills Assessment 

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. 

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 

3. Assessment Review 

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. 

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview
Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview – CTO 

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. 

Required Qualifications 

- 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production. 
- Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction. 
- Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging. 
- Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras. 
- Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs. 
- Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design. 
- Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
- Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code. 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods. 
- SQL database knowledge. 
- Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain. 
- Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure. 
- Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results. 

Compensation & Benefits 

- Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise. 
- Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel. 
- 90-day probationary period. 
- Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including: 
- Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy. 
- Holiday pay for company-observed holidays. 
- Career growth and professional development opportunities.

title: Senior/ Lead AI Deployment Engineer - Supply Chain
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team 

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with strong platform expertise and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role 

As a Senior/ Lead Deployment Engineer, you are the hands-on owner of Celonis delivery for your customers. You run the engagement end to end —understanding the business challenge, designing and building the solution on the platform, driving its adoption, and quantifying the value it delivers.

What sets the role apart is the depth you bring —platform mastery, domain & process insight, and the customer relationships— that turn a working solution into business-critical value. Celonis's AI tooling accelerates the build, so your time goes to the solution design, the customer, and the outcome.

The Work You’ll Do 

- Run discovery workshops with business and IT stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases.

- Build and configure the analytical core on the platform—data models, process analyses, and dashboards —directing Celonis's AI deployment tooling to move fast and validating every output for accuracy and business relevance.

- Lead value workshops to pinpoint root causes of process inefficiencies and define the KPIs that quantify business impact.

- Design and deploy the operational solutions —automations, action flows, and AI-powered insights— that put the platform to work in users' day-to-day decisions.

- Present business cases to senior (VP- and C-level) stakeholders and secure their sign-off on the value realization plan.

- Drive adoption: Enable key users to run and extend the solution independently, and document design decisions for a clean handover.

- Manage delivery against timeline, scope, and customer expectations.

- Act as a subject-matter expert in pre-sales, helping shape and scope engagements (approach, solution blueprint, and effort estimates).

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era 

- You work with AI agents as your primary tools - You set the direction while AI agents do the heavy lifting of the build—bringing the intent, context, and judgment that make the output right for the customer.

- You turn ambiguous business needs into precise, executable intent—the specification and context engineering craft that most separates great delivery from average.

- You work at the frontier, experimenting as the tools evolve, finding what works, and raising the bar for the whole team. 

- You build to last—AI reaches a first result in minutes, and you make sure what ships is robust, intuitive, and ready to scale. 

The Qualifications You Need 

- Supply Chain Experience: 4+ years in Management, IT or data consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors. For Senior DE: 6+ years with demonstrated project leadership.

- Systems fluency : Hands-on familiarity with the systems where supply chain runs: SAP (MM/SD/PP, S/4HANA, APO/IBP) or equivalents such as Oracle, Kinaxis, o9, or Blue Yonder. 

- Data & technical skills: Deep data fluency: proficiency in SQL and Python, strong data-modelling skills, and ease turning large, complex datasets into an analysis-ready foundation. You reason about data structurally, with an instinct for relationships, granularity, and data quality. Prior hands-on experience with Celonis is a plus. 

- AI fluency: Curiosity and comfort using AI-assisted tools in your work (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.), and the willingness to keep learning as they evolve. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

- Business and process expertise : Strong understanding / deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise Supply Chain processes and performance metrics. 

- Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.

- Consulting & communication: Ability to steer customer workshops, present to management, manage expectations, and deliver through ambiguity—equally at ease with technical and business audiences.

- Languages: Professional fluency in French and English is required.

- Education: Master’s in Supply Chain, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

- Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

We know that exceptional candidates don't always match every qualification listed in a job description. We value potential, diverse perspectives, and transferable skills. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe your experience could add value, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement! 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video .

Celonis Inclusion Statement: 

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. 

Your Privacy: 

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices 

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process .

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools 

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description:
About the Role 

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do 

Program Planning & Execution 

- Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
- Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
- Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
- Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.
PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes 

- Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
- Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
- Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
- Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.
Risk, Issue & Performance Management 

- Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
- Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
- Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
- Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.
AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement 

- Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
- Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
- Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.
Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration 

- Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
- Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
- Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
- Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.
Requirements 

What You'll Need 

Required Qualifications & Experience 

- At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

- Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

- A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

- Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

- Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

- Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

- Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

- Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

- Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus 

- Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

- Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

- Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

- Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have 

- Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

- Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

- Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are 

- You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

- You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

- You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

- You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

- You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

- You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

- You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

- You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

- You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

- You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

- You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer 

- A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

- The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

- Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

- The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data die het verschil maakt 

Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap?

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Je draagt bij aan platformen die er echt toe doen: data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen bij NS, moderne beleggingsplatformen bij Robeco en schaalbare data ecosystemen bij EDSN en Stedin. Je ontwerpt en bouwt schaalbare data pipelines in Cloud omgevingen, ontwikkelt betrouwbare datamodellen die organisatiebreed worden gebruikt en denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance en onderhoudbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je plek binnen LINKIT 

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in leren, verbinden en vooruitkijken.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.

Wat we vragen 

- 5+ jaar ervaring in data engineering binnen complexe omgevingen.

- Sterke programmeervaardigheden in talen zoals Python, Scala en SQL.

- Kennis van of ervaring met distributed data processing frameworks/datalakes/orchestrators zoals Spark, Flink, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Airflow, dbt, etc.

- Ruime ervaring met production ELT/ETL-pipelines.

- Ervaring met batch/streaming dataverwerking.

- Ervaring met CI/CD op cloudplatformen.

- Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

- Je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en spreekt vloeiend Engels.

- Pré: ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric of BigQuery.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt 

- Salaris tussen €5.700-€7.400 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

- Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

- Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

- 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

- Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

- Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

- Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure 

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

- Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

- Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

- Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Tabea Hensel via 

Over ons 

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Senior Data Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Model Risk Management (R14365)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

Who We Are 

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. 

Location Note 

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. 

The Opportunity 

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards. 

This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun. 

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. 

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities. 

- You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations. 

- You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities. 

- You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation. 

- You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards. 

- You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships. 

- You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

- You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. 

- You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices. 

- You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes. 

- You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio. 

- You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review. 

- You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster 

Who You Are 

The right fit looks like this 

You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis. 

You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders. 

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required 

- 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field. 

- Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods. 

- Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows. 

- Experience developing or validating consumer credit loss forecasting models using methods such as vintage/cohort analysis, roll-rate or transition models, survival analysis, time-series models, or probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) frameworks.Strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar quantitative programming tools. 

- Experience working with large datasets and performing advanced statistical analysis, model testing, or performance evaluation. 

- Strong understanding of model validation techniques, performance metrics, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stability analysis, and ongoing monitoring. 

- Experience evaluating model assumptions, data quality, limitations, implementation, and business use. 

- Experience independently leading complex analytical or validation work from scoping through final conclusions. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and explain complex model risks clearly. 

- Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. 

- Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with model developers, Risk, Compliance, and senior stakeholders. 

Nice to Have 

- Experience in model risk management or independent model validation. 

- Experience with credit risk, fraud risk, consumer lending, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. 

- Familiarity with model governance frameworks, model inventories, risk tiering, validation schedules, issue management, or regulatory expectations. 

- Experience validating machine learning or AI models. 

- Experience developing or validating liquidity, funding, or cash-flow forecasting models, including evaluating funding needs and liquidity under stress scenarios. 

- Familiarity with capital markets models used for loan valuation or securitization, including assessing how key assumptions affect valuations and projected cash flows.Experience with AWS, SageMaker, Databricks, or other cloud-based analytics and modeling platforms. 

- Experience with Spark, PySpark, Hive, or other large-scale data technologies. 

- Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline. 

- Experience using AI-assisted tools to support research, coding, documentation, validation, or quantitative analysis. 

Our AI Mindset 

We b uild with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together . 

Why Oportun 

What's in it for you 

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: 

India Benefits: 

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance 

Provident Fund 

Life & Accident Insurance 

Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances 

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. 

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ .

title: Data Platform Lead
description:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Klanten willen zien wat hun leren oplevert, de business wil sturen op cijfers die kloppen en onze AI-ambities staan of vallen met goede data. Daarom zoeken we een Data Platform Lead die het fundament bouwt waar heel Studytube op draait. 

De rol 

Data werkt bij Studytube als hub-and-spoke. Jij leidt de hub: het gedeelde dataplatform binnen Engineering, met infrastructuur, pipelines, het lakehouse en de gedeelde datamodellen. De spokes zitten in de business, van finance en product tot Customer Success en GTM. Zij bouwen de analyses en dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt, vindbaar is en meebeweegt met het product. 

Je rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering en geeft leiding aan de data engineer. Op termijn breiden we het team uit met een analytics engineer. Je bent een player-coach: je zet de koers uit en bouwt zelf mee. 

Wat je doet 

- Je bent eigenaar van het dataplatform en de architectuur, en stelt de roadmap op samen met de spokes. 

- Je zorgt voor één versie van de waarheid. De spokes bepalen wat een actieve learner is, jij zorgt dat die definitie één keer gebouwd wordt en overal hetzelfde getal oplevert. 

- Je bouwt het platform als product: self-service, documentatie en heldere afspraken, zodat analisten zelfstandig vooruit kunnen. 

- Je legt het datafundament voor AI, voor features in het product en voor interne toepassingen op bedrijfsdata. Je team bouwt zelf sneller met AI-tools. 

- Je neemt het Databricks-platform over van een externe partij, inclusief een high-security omgeving, en denkt mee over de toekomst van onze stack. 

- Je richt governance in het platform in: toegang, datakwaliteit, lineage, retentie en verwijdering, GDPR-proof. 

- Je weegt verzoeken van de spokes tegen elkaar af en legt je keuzes uit, ook als het antwoord nee is. 

- Je coacht het team, werft mee aan de uitbreiding en spreidt kennis, zodat niets van één persoon afhangt. 

Je hebt eerder een dataplatform opgezet of volwassen gemaakt, het liefst in een scale-up. Je bent technisch diep, maar denkt vanuit je gebruikers: een analist die een tabel niet vindt of niet vertrouwt, is voor jou een platformprobleem. Je legt trade-offs uit aan zowel de directie als een developer. 

Je bent pragmatisch, nieuwsgierig naar wat AI verandert aan het vak en haalt energie uit het laten groeien van anderen. 

Must-haves 

- 8+ jaar ervaring in data, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar als lead van een team of platform. 

- Hands-on ervaring in de hele keten: een cloud data platform en pipelines, en SQL, dbt en Python in productie. 

- Databricks in productie (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), bij voorkeur op Azure.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. 

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. 

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. 

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

• Conversation design or UX writing experience

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions 

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

title: Software Engineer - Secure Container Images
description:
With more than 10 billion pulls , Canonical's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to hardened, production-ready images.

As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence.

Nice-to-have skills

If your experience is close but does not match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience from Linux packaging, release engineering, build systems, platform engineering, and open-source maintenance.
