title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

- Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

- Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

- Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

- Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving

About you

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

- 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

- Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

- Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

- You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

- You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

- You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

- You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

- You're mainly a backend engineer, but you're comfortable enough to touch a modern React app

- You use AI tools well and honestly. Reach for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or whatever helps, and be clear about where you did and didn't

- You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs

Nice to have

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

- Close familiarity with a major cloud data or analytics platform ecosystem

- Real depth in auth and identity federation, or experience building to a partner's security review, marketplace requirements or certification requirements

- Hands-on experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms, or the isolation and deployment topology behind them

- Working knowledge of ClickHouse, or another columnar / OLAP engine

Perks 

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

About this role 

You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. - Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow

- Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec

- Collaborate across automation and software to help build network monitoring, telemetry, and automation that let a small team run a large fleet, and be the top escalation point for AI Fabric incidents

- Document as you go so each new site is faster than the last, and help hire and mentor the network engineers who join after you

Qualifications:

- A track record of taking GPU fabrics from empty racks to production, with your own hands on the work, not only through vendors or integrators

- 400G/800G OSFP optics, AOC/DAC, MPO trunking

title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics & Research
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on. 

The Difference You Will Make: 

The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.

If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you.

A Typical Day: 

- Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze

- Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others

- Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business

- Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders

- Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards

- Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting

- Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb

- Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver

Your Expertise: 

- 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field

- Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis

- Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access

- Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit

- Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data

- Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact

- Experience working with large practical datasets

Your Location: 

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You: 

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

$180,000 — $210,000 USD

description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

Why Join Coalition Technologies? 

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

- 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

- Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

- Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

- Subsidized gym memberships

- Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

- International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

- Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

- Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

- Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

Office Assistant Responsibilities 

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

- Answering phones and emails

- Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

- Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

- Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

- Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

- Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

- Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

- Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

- Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

- Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

Required Skills and Qualifications 

The ideal candidate will have:

- Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

- Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

- Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

- Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

Preferred Skills 

- The following experience is preferred but not required:

- Intermediate spreadsheet skills

- Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

- Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

- Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

Remote Work Environment 

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

Growth Opportunity 

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

Compensation 

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: Staff Tech Enablement Engineer, B2B Operations
description:
About CookUnity :

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. 

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

As part of our B2B Operations, the Tech Enablement team serves as a central tech hub connecting Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, CX, and Operations. We focus on building internal tools and automations that streamline workflows and reduce manual work across teams. By unifying systems and data and leveraging a mix of low-code platforms and custom development, Tech Enablement drives efficiency and scalable growth for CookUnity’s B2B business. This small, cross-functional team wears many hats – from creating process automations and integrations, to building and maintaining smart hardware solutions – all in the service of empowering our Ops team and other departments to work smarter and faster.

The role:

- We are looking for a Staff Tech Enablement Engineer to lead the technology that supports CookUnity's B2B operations and Smart Fridges program.

- You will manage and develop a Tech Enablement Engineer, work hands-on with the engineer covering Smart Fridges hardware and OS, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Healthcare, Sales, Marketing, and CX leaders.

- You will own the direction and reliability of our internal tools, automations, and integrations while leading the hardware and operating-system work needed to deploy and support hundreds of Smart Fridges.

- This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set priorities and technical standards, review architecture and code, investigate difficult software and device issues, and make sure each solution has a clear owner and support model.

- You will help the team move quickly without creating fragile workflows, undocumented devices, or systems that cannot be operated safely at scale.

Responsibilities: 

- Team Leadership & Prioritization: Manage, coach, and develop the Tech Enablement Engineer. Own intake, capacity, roadmap, delivery commitments, and communication with B2B and Product & Engineering leaders. Make tradeoffs visible and focus the team on measurable business impact.

- Build & Optimize Automations: Lead the design, delivery, and operation of workflows that remove manual work across B2B. Use low-code tools such as n8n and custom software where each is appropriate. Ensure critical jobs have monitoring, failure handling, recovery paths, and clear ownership.

- Full-Stack Internal Tools: Guide the development of internal web and mobile tools, dashboards, and services for Operations, Healthcare, CX, Sales, and Smart Fridges. Contribute directly to complex work, establish sound engineering practices, and decide when a prototype needs to become a supported product.

- Hardware (IoT) & Smart Fridge OS: Own the technical direction for Smart Fridges hardware and embedded Linux software alongside the hardware engineer. Work across compute devices, locks, sensors, cameras, connectivity, and on-device computer vision. Partner with manufacturers and field teams on component choices, build quality, installation, device debugging, and failure analysis.

- Fleet Scale & Reliability: Turn one-device-at-a-time setup and updates into repeatable imaging, enrollment, remote deployment, staged releases, rollback, and central fleet-health monitoring. Define release gates, security controls, and operational measures so hundreds of fridges can be deployed, updated, and supported without proportional growth in manual work or site visits.

- Third-Party Integrations: Lead reliable data flows between CookUnity systems and platforms such as Salesforce, support tools, logistics services, and healthcare partners. Work with system owners on API and webhook contracts, data quality, credentials, and incident response.

- Security & Operational Readiness: Partner with Security, Legal, Infrastructure, and Engineering on access, secrets, auditability, and reviews for customer and healthcare data. Build runbooks, alerting, and recovery procedures for business-critical workflows and field devices.

- Documentation & Handover: Keep source-of-truth links, architecture decisions, device build and release procedures, deployment steps, and operational playbooks current. Decide with Product and Engineering which services Tech Enablement will maintain, which prototypes should be productized, and which should be retired.

- AI Tools & Agents: Identify practical opportunities to use AI in B2B operations and engineering workflows. Evaluate prototypes for measurable value, reliability, data protection, and a sustainable owner before scaling them.

Minimum requirements : 

- Experience managing engineers, including coaching, feedback, prioritization, and accountability for delivery.

- Strong hands-on software engineering experience across backend services, integrations, and internal applications, with proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python and working knowledge of SQL.

- Hands-on experience building and operating physical devices with embedded Linux or comparable IoT software in the field. You can diagnose problems across device hardware, sensors, connectivity, operating-system services, and cloud systems.

- Demonstrated experience scaling a device fleet beyond hand-configured deployments, including reproducible provisioning, remote software updates, staged releases and rollback, telemetry, security, and field support.

- Experience designing reliable production workflows using APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and third-party systems, including retries, idempotency, monitoring, and data reconciliation.

- Experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, access management, and incident response for systems that business teams depend on.

- Sound judgment about security and privacy, including when to involve specialist reviewers for sensitive customer or healthcare data.

- Ability to turn ambiguous operational needs into priorities, technical plans, and clear decisions with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Helping to have higher levels of uptime & supporting the on-call rotation that will help the business run 24/7

- Fluent English communication skills , written and spoken, for collaboration across teams and regions.

Preferred requirements: 

- Experience with Raspberry Pi or similar edge devices, and with AWS IoT Greengrass, SSM, MQTT, or comparable fleet-management tools.

- Experience with camera pipelines, computer vision at the edge, hardware manufacturing, or device quality assurance.

- Experience with n8n or similar automation platforms and with Salesforce or other CRM integrations.

- Experience building internal applications with React/Next.js and Node.js or Python, and deploying them on cloud platforms.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations or workflows involving PHI-sensitive data.

- Experience with customer support, marketing, or logistics tools and their APIs.

- Experience applying AI tools to operational workflows while checking output quality, privacy, and business impact.

- Comfort leading a small team across software, hardware, vendors, and business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

Benefits:

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.

⛱ Enjoy 15 business days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider.

🗓️ 5-year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical.

🐣 Paid family leave.

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! 

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. 

A quick note for all candidates 
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us: 

- Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com 

- Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page . 

- We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. 

- We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. 

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

title: Staff Software Engineer, eCommerce
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff’s E-commerce team builds an app-to-web product that drives mobile app users to purchase on Shopify web stores. We operate like a startup inside Liftoff. Requirements shift as we learn from live customers, and most problems arrive without an internal playbook. We built the product from the ground up and have already shipped major performance wins.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll turn ambiguous problems into sound designs and execution plans, then drive them to production. You’ll own architecture and technical decisions for core targeting and attribution systems, and help shape the team’s work through design and code review. When customer performance drops, you’ll trace the cause through our systems, determine whether it’s a bug or a market signal, and turn the finding into a design.

Responsibilities: 

- Own epics end to end, including scoping, design, delivery, and production health.

- Help set the team’s technical direction and long-term roadmap.

- Build privacy-compliant data systems that expand reach while maintaining accuracy.

- Design attribution logic that captures more of the purchases we drive without overcounting.

- Lead customer performance deep dives and turn findings into experiments.

- Research new tools and approaches, and recommend solutions that balance short-term and long-term needs.

- Review design docs and PRs, and help set the team’s bar for reliability, scalability, observability, privacy, cost efficiency, and documentation.

- Partner with ML engineers to improve conversion models, including training data and conversion signal quality.

- Build and extend our Shopify app and web pixel.

- Mentor engineers and help hold the senior engineering bar in interviews.

- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

- Minimum Bachelors Degree and 8 yrs of relevant experience. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in place of a formal degree.

- Experience leading the design and delivery of complex projects across multiple engineers.

- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus fluent SQL (Trino, Spark, or equivalent).

- A track record of taking ambiguous problems from scoping to shipped outcome with minimal oversight.

- Demonstrated ability to diagnose performance or data discrepancies across a multi-stage pipeline, from raw signal to reported outcome.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and event-driven systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent).

- You operate with Agency and Urgency by taking initiative to solve problems and drive outcomes independently, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- You have a Growth Mindset and are adaptable, quick to test, iterate, and improve both ideas and your own skill set.

- Experience with identity resolution, probabilistic matching, or device graphs is a plus.

NICE TO HAVE: 

- Experience with web attribution or conversion tracking, such as pixels, server-side conversion APIs, or attribution platforms.

- Working knowledge of browser privacy constraints and data privacy regulations.

- Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

Working at Liftoff is fast-paced, fun, and challenging, and we thrive on innovation. Come join our team and help shape the future of the mobile app ecosystem. If this role sounds interesting to you, we would love to hear from you!

Location:
This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA. 

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City. 

Travel Expectations: 
We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

title: SaaS Engineer
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role 

We are seeking a talented SaaS Engineer to take ownership of the full lifecycle of our SaaS and Software portfolio, from spend and license management to day-to-day governance and tooling policies. This will cover both Internal IT and Engineering SaaS and Software used across Mistral.

You will be the go-to person for everything SaaS: how much we spend, who has access, whether our tools are secure and compliant, and how new tools are evaluated and approved. You will map our AI connectors, integrations, MCPs and other tooling, define the associated policies, and report on costs and usage. Working closely with Security, Compliance, Finance, IAM and Procurement, you will help define and enforce how software is adopted across the company.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise, financial ownership and operational governance, this role offers the opportunity to shape how a fast-growing global organization manages and scales its software ecosystem.

What You Will Do 

SaaS Cost and Billing Management 

- Own the SaaS budget: track spend, forecast costs, and report on SaaS expenditure to Finance and IT leadership.

- Manage vendor contracts, renewals, and license tiers, working closely with our Procurement Manager and negotiating pricing at renewal where relevant.

- Regularly audit licenses and seats, reclaim unused seats, and eliminate redundant or overlapping tools.

- Work with IT leadership to define policies and budgets related to AI usage across Mistral.

- Detect and reduce shadow IT spend and consolidate vendors wherever possible.

- Build and maintain a complete and accurate SaaS inventory, including costs, owners, contracts, and renewal dates.

SaaS Governance and Operations 

- Ensure SAML/SSO and SCIM provisioning are enforced across all supported SaaS applications, working with our IT Engineers and IT DevOps teams to close existing gaps.

- Design and roll out RBAC policies across our SaaS portfolio.

- Run periodic user and access reviews, auditing accounts, licenses, permissions, and privileged access while ensuring proper offboarding cleanup.

- Keep collaboration and engineering tools clean, organized, and properly managed.

- Define and enforce naming conventions, ownership rules, and lifecycle policies for SaaS accounts and workspaces.

- Act as the escalation point for SaaS access issues and tooling-related questions from across the business.

SaaS Assessment and Policy 

- Define and maintain the company's SaaS and Software assessment and procurement policies, covering intake, evaluation, approval, and decommissioning workflows.

- Lead new tool evaluations in partnership with Security (vendor risk assessments and security reviews), Compliance (data protection, GDPR and DPAs), Finance (budget impact), and Procurement (contracting).

- Maintain a vendor risk and compliance matrix for the existing SaaS portfolio, tracking certifications such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, as well as data processing agreements.

- Own the internal tool catalog: publish approved tools, highlight restricted ones, and guide employees toward compliant alternatives.

- Contribute to IT policy documentation and internal training and awareness around software and tool usage.

What We're Looking For 

- 3–5+ years of experience in IT operations, SaaS management, IT asset management, or a similar role.

- Hands-on experience administering IT SaaS platforms, including SSO/IdP solutions such as Okta, Entra ID and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, and tools such as Slack, Notion, Bitwarden and Microsoft 365 or equivalent.

- Hands-on experience with engineering and cloud platforms such as GitHub, GCP, AWS and Azure.

- Proven experience in license and seat management, as well as SaaS spend optimization.

- Familiarity with AI tooling and models, including Mistral and other providers, and an understanding of how they integrate into SaaS environments, billing, and budgets.

- Good understanding of identity and access management concepts, including SAML, SCIM, RBAC, and the principle of least privilege.

- Familiarity with vendor security reviews and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

- Experience working cross-functionally with Security, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Procurement teams.

- Strong organizational skills and a documented, process-driven mindset.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. French is a plus.

Bonus:

- Experience with SaaS management platforms such as BetterCloud, Torii, Productiv, Nexthink, or Vanta/Drata for compliance.

- Familiarity with ITIL or similar process frameworks.

- Experience negotiating contracts and pricing with SaaS vendors.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

Our Experience team owns the core product experience at Netlify, which is every way a human or an agent interacts with the platform, from our React-based web application to CLI, MCP, SDK, and API. If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. We're reimagining how developers experience web development by thoughtfully integrating AI into our workflows - not as a novelty, but as a practical tool that enhances how we build the web.

With our team, you'll help set technical direction for our product area, mentor a highly senior team of engineers, and shape user experiences that serve millions of developers. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, shape technical direction, and move quickly while collaborating closely with Product and Design.

- Own the technical direction for our product area, including the web app, CLI, MCP, SDK, API, and docs, by defining architecture and roadmap alongside your manager, Product, and Design, and make tradeoffs explicit so decisions are easy to understand and revisit

- Design and evolve user-facing features and product APIs for both humans and agents, recognizing that the best interface isn’t always a React application. Build them to scale to millions of developers worldwide, with a clear view of reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

- Make thoughtful product and interface decisions on your own with the overall customer experience top of mind

- Set the bar for engineering practices - testing, documentation, observability, and performance optimization - and lead how the team pragmatically uses AI tools, sharing what works and what doesn't

- Turn ambiguity into clear plans, guiding both early-stage prototypes and production-ready applications that directly impact user experience and business metrics

- Mentor and grow engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and sponsorship, raising the technical level of the whole team

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and engineering leadership to shape user flows that enhance the developer experience across our platform, and contribute to hiring and team growth

What You'll Bring

- A history of building interfaces developers use directly, such as web apps, CLIs, APIs, SDKs, or other dev tools, and a strong sense of what works well for developers (and, by extension, agents)

- Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI

- Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.

- Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance

- Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

- Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production

- A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus

- Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

- Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others

- Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same

- Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners

- Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed

- A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals

- Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices

- Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

This Role is a Great Fit If 

- You're energized by building user-facing products and features that directly impact millions of developers' daily workflows

- You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality

- You enjoy the autonomy and influence of staff-level work - setting technical direction, writing RFCs, and driving decisions across teams while staying connected to the people doing the work

- You find satisfaction in making other engineers better, whether through mentoring, design reviews, or setting a clear example

- You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others

- You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it

- You're excited by new tools, challenges, and opportunities to grow, even when they feel a little uncomfortable at first

- You want to work on a fully remote team that believes in autonomy, transparency, and building a better web, together

Applying

When applying please include:

We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. - You'll own reusable pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, scoring, deployment, and ongoing model monitoring. 

- You'll partner with Marketing, Growth, Product, and Engineering to translate model outputs into actionable acquisition strategies and reliable production workflows. 

- You'll measure model effectiveness and business impact through new member acquisition, targeting accuracy, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and production reliability. 

Who You Are

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required

- Strong Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets. 

- Experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, such as logistic regression and gradient boosting, to business problems. 

- Experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring production machine learning models.

Nice to Have

- Experience with internal prospect and application funnel data, marketing engagement data, third-party consumer or alternative data, or credit bureau data.

- Advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Resilience
description:

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Vinted’s new Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be joining the Platform Resilience team (Service Ecosystem domain). The purpose of our team is ensuring stable and resilient growth of the Vinted Marketplace services ecosystem. The team consists exclusively of experienced backend engineers, ensuring you always have someone to discuss your ideas with.

Here are some of the technologies we use: Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq, Golang, MySQL, Vitess, Redis, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Elastic APM, Datadog, Backstage, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Unix/Linux, Istio, ArgoCD.

Take a look at https://vinted.engineering/ to get a sense of our challenges.

In this position, you’ll 

- Develop platform capabilities that help all Marketplace engineers build scalable systems.

- Investigate and improve overall system stability and performance.

- Consult other engineers on how to build robust systems with high availability.

- Craft code that affects more than 80M+ users and handles 10M+ requests per minute.

- Participate in on-call rotation every 5-6 weeks.

About you 

- Experience building and supporting large-scale applications.

- Good understanding of how infrastructure and code work together.

- A strong communicator, skilled in discussing complex topics and collaborating across cultures in spoken and written English.

- Analytical and acute problem-solving skills.

- Eager to learn and master new technologies and concepts.

- Familiar with most and have deep knowledge in some of the following disciplines (depending on your seniority level): Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Structures and Algorithms.

- You are motivated by challenging, complex engineering problems requiring deep technological understanding, perseverance, collaboration with other developers, and solutions beyond regular product development

- Advantage: experience with Distributed Systems, event-driven architecture, performance optimization and monitoring.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Frequent team-building events

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per working day

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

- NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

- Company bike leasing scheme

- Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

- Work from Home allowance 

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:

€76.800 — €104.000 EUR

This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. - Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline

- Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others

- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

- Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

- Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 

- Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

- Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering

- 
Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

- 
Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

- 
Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With: 

- Python

- Redshift, PostgreSQL

- Data build tool (dbt) 

- WS, G Suite, Mac

- Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Platform Engineer
We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams.

The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain. 

We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering

You will be responsible for: 

- Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices.
- Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling.
- Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves.
- Running GitLab and other shared platform services: upgrades, patching, monitoring and recovery.
- Making sure every platform change goes through a reviewed pipeline.
- Making and owning the technical decisions in your domain, using spikes to test options and escalating early when needed.
- Commanding platform incidents, and following through on post-mortems.
- Improving the security of the services you own, in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
- Using AI tools in your daily work and helping others do the same.
- Mentoring engineers, giving useful feedback.
- Shaping engineering standards through our guilds
- Partnering with product teams early, understanding their plans before they need us, and making Platform Core easy to work with.
- Aligning teams on approach before work starts, and explaining trade-offs in terms of risk and value.
- Using platform metrics and support data to argue for what to do next, and shaping new work with your team before it is defined
About you 

- Several years in platform, infrastructure, with clear ownership of production platforms used by other engineering teams.
- Deep hands-on Terraform (or OpenTofu) on AWS, including module design and multi-account or multi-tenant setups.
- Expert with Kubernetes (EKS) and containers; experience running cluster upgrades and Helm or Kustomize at scale.
- Strong in GitLab CI and designing reusable pipelines and templates for many teams.
- Professional depth in core AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS, EKS). GCP exposure is a bonus.
- Experience with, or strong interest in, modern cloud networking such as AWS VPC Lattice and service mesh with support for identity-based access between services
- Fluent in Bash and Python for automation; comfortable on Linux 
- Practical observability experience with Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Grafana, including defining SLIs and alerting.
- Security-minded: IAM least privilege, secrets management, container supply-chain security, and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework and DSOMM.
- Experience leading production incidents and making technical decisions you own, including when they turn out wrong.
- Have grown other engineers and can explain complex trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
We’ll treat you with: 

- 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays 
- Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too 
- Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process
Equal Opportunities

About us 

We're solving AI's hardest problem: alignment. 

Encord is the data layer for Physical AI and enterprise, serving as core infrastructure for 300+ of the world's leading AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, Hitachi, Skydio, AbbVie and Dyna, Walden and Agility Robotics. From autonomous vehicles and robotics to sports and healthcare, we're solving AI's hardest problem: turning complex, real-world data into production-ready intelligent systems.

We're a team of founders, scientists, quants, researchers, and former Olympians, who’ve helped build some of the most successful companies in Silicon Valley, and alumni of MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Oxford, Cambridge, and Imperial. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

We're looking for exceptional people who want to help build a category-defining company, operating with high urgency and taking real ownership to help shape the future of AI.

Quant Developer in AI 

You're a quant developer. You've built high-performance systems that process billions of events per day in real-time, and you care deeply about consistency, correctness and performance. Now you want to build in AI

This is your chance. Encord is a scale-up serving the frontier of physical AI and robotics, the largest technological revolution in history, where what you build ships fast and you own it. Help us build the AI data platform for the future of robotics.

The role 

You know how to build systems that are fast and correct under pressure. The hardest problems in AI right now are data problems: distributed, data-intensive systems that have to stay correct and performant at scale.

You will join the Foundations team, who build the data systems that enable frontier robotics labs to generate, understand, train, and test on massive volumes of robotics data. We don’t just react to an order book tick - you will need to handle large 3D scenes, hour-long videos, LIDAR point clouds, and ML inference, all under tight performance and operational budgets.

Why now? A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 180 and still accelerating. You'll work directly with a high-bar team, take on high-stakes problems, and help shape where the platform goes next.

What you'll do 

- Design, build, deploy and own data systems processing petabytes of data across billions of items, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring and measuring impact

- Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load

- Design performant protocols and APIs, and tackle complex domains and immense scale with correct and pragmatic solutions, moving extremely fast while maintaining engineering quality.

- Build as part of a high-performing team, contribute your knowledge and experience to others.

Who you are 

- You have personally developed and maintained systems from scratch, and know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed. You will have excelled at something demanding, and can show that your good technical decisions day after day compounded into a competitive edge.

- You may not have AI or ML experience, and that's fine: you are an incredibly fast and curious learner . You can pick up a new topic and quickly become an expert by being ego-less in asking the right questions, and rigorous in performing experiments that propel you up the learning curve.

- You excel under pressure and uncertainty. You don’t let up the pace, you attack the heart of the problem, and you repeatedly make the right tradeoffs.

- You deeply care about the systems you build. You take pride in having thought through the failure modes, shipping readable, bulletproof code, and delivering today instead of next week.

- You enjoy being a member of a high-performing team. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you.

Experience requirements 

- 1-5+ years building and operating serious institutional-scale systems.

- Fluency in Python or Typescript and a deep understanding of a least one of Rust, C++, Java or Golang.

- Solid core CS knowledge in data structures and algorithms, distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and how they behave under load

- Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout and monitoring

- Experience at a trading firm, market maker, hedge fund or exchange is a plus: trading systems, market data pipelines, tick or time-series stores, risk engines, ML/QR research pipelines, are all relevant to what we build. Experience with large data migrations or re-architecture projects is a plus.

Why Encord 

- Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

- Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

- Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

- Daily team lunches & dinners

- Annual learning & development budget

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

- US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

- UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus UK public holidays

- Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

- Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials 

Operating principles 

High agency 

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency 

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry 

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time 

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

title: Backend Engineer, Knowledge Graph
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Canada; Remote, United States

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.

The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.

In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.

What you’ll do 

- Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.

- Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.

- Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.

- Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.

- Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.

- Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.

- Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.

- Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).

What you’ll bring 

- Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).

- Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.

- Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.

- Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.

- Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.

- A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).

- Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.

- Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.

About the team 

GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. We work closely with partners across AI (Duo Agent Platform), analytics, infrastructure and delivery, and security because our work spans many parts of the platform.

We collaborate asynchronously rather than following a feature factory model. A key challenge for us right now is scaling sustainably as usage grows and team members take time off. That includes hardening multi-tenant behavior. At the same time, we're bringing Knowledge Graph to

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
Senior AI/ML Engineer, remote in Canada: own the AI that assesses patients for US healthcare providers and gets them to the right mental health care faster. 

About Limbic 

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomized, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role 

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will take ownership of the AI in our clinical assessment product for US healthcare organizations. A patient describes what they are struggling with in a conversation with our AI, which gathers their history, administers standard clinical questionnaires such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, detects risk and recommends a treatment program for the organization’s clinicians to review. Every organization configures it for its own services, so the AI has to be safe and accurate across many clinical setups, not just one.

The approach is proven at scale in the NHS, where it increased referrals from minority groups by 29%, as published in Nature Medicine. You will work in North American hours alongside product, engineering and clinical colleagues, in close collaboration with our ML team in London. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across Limbic.

What You’ll Do 

- 
Own the quality of the conversational AI that runs patient assessments, from each step of the conversation to clinical prediction and treatment recommendation.

- 
Improve the safety checks that screen every patient message and AI reply, covering risk, attempts to manipulate the AI, unsafe medical advice and clinically inappropriate responses, so they catch more problems without flagging good replies.

- 
Productionize ML models that optimize product KPIs, including the accuracy of clinical predictions and how quickly patients reach the right care.

- 
Build and maintain evaluation harnesses, simulated patient conversations and labelled transcript review, so every configuration can be tested before a patient sees it.

- 
Extend our assessment AI to new channels, including the phone, so that patients who cannot or will not use a web form still have a way in.

- 
Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys.

- 
Build agents and tooling that automate product development workflows, including reliable testing and customer demos.

- 
Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring 

- 
You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

- 
A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

- 
OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

- 
Expertise in productizing LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development.

- 
Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.

- 
Proven experience building an LLM agent harness .

- 
Experience utilizing reinforcement learning.

- 
Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

- 
A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

- 
Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL).

- 
Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerization technologies.

- 
A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high.

- 
A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space.

- 
Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organizations as customers.

- 
North American business hours (Eastern time preferred), with daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3).

- 
Based in Canada with the right to work there.

- 
Please note: Limbic cannot provide visa sponsorship in Canada.

Benefits & Wellbeing 

- 
Salary: CA$173,000 – CA$192,000 per year.

- 
Equity share options.

- 
25 days PTO.

- 
Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

- 
Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

- 
Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.
