title: Control & Estimation Intern
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission 

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities 

- Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

- Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

- Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

- Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

- Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

- Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements 

- Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

- Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

- Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Team Atlas
description:
About the Role 

Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit and risk, in real time. We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and the backend is where the hard problems live.

We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banking and insurance, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join Team Atlas : a small, high-ownership team focused on the data infrastructure powering our feature computation platform. 

You'll own critical systems end-to-end, and your decisions will shape the product.

What You'll Do 

- Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

- Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scale are everyday concerns.

- Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

- Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built.

- Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes.

- Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next.

Requirements 

- At least 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years).

- Deep expertise building backend systems on cloud platforms, we use AWS.

- Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them.

- Depth in at least one of these areas: data pipelines and storage, event-driven architectures, caching and performance, or serverless systems. You don't need all of them.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision.

- The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required 

- Python, FastAPI, Apache Iceberg, AWS Athena, AWS Glue, or Apache Spark

- Streaming / real-time data pipelines (Kinesis)

- Multi-level caching strategies (Redis, DynamoDB, in-memory)

- Serverless at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation)

Our Offer 

- Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

- Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

- Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

- Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

- Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

- Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance 

- We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

- We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us 

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. 

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. 

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. 

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com .

About Your Employment . Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process. 

Your Privacy . Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references. 

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities. 

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)). 

Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates’ data becomes part of their employment records. 

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent. 

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review. 

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms. 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood Taktile’s Applicant Privacy Policy. To exercise your rights or ask questions, contact Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Modern Health is hiring a Staff Analytics Engineer to help shape our modeled data layer and partner with Product and Engineering on how our products are measured. You'll lead projects across our dbt project, backend service migrations, and product event instrumentation in Mixpanel, and raise the bar on data modeling for the whole team. You'll be a full member of a small analytics team that shares modeling, ad-hoc requests, on-call, and reporting. You'll report to the Manager, Data Analytics, and work closely with Data Engineering, Product, and Engineering.

- Build and review dbt models with the team — design, tests, documentation, deprecation of legacy tables, and the Looker Explores built on them — and help set the modeling conventions the team works to.

- Lead the Analytics side of backend service migrations: review schemas and requests for comment (RFCs, Engineering's design docs) with Engineering before they ship, define what must land in Snowflake, plan the modeling with the team, and keep internal and client-facing reporting continuous through cutover.

- Lead product event instrumentation work in Mixpanel: maintain the event lexicon, write tracking requirements for new surfaces, quality-check shipped events, and build the dbt models that bring Mixpanel and Iterable data into governed Looker reporting.

- Partner with product and engineering teams: attend syncs, shape measurement and tracking design before build, and deliver launch reporting on governed marts rather than one-off dashboards.

- Make the modeled layer readable by people and AI tools alike: certified metric definitions in our semantic layer, complete dbt documentation, and the generated documentation and context layer that agents and Glean read from.

- Drive the staging layer, data quality tests, and continuous integration (CI) enforcement in the dbt repo, partnering with Data Engineering where the work crosses into ingestion and platform.

- Build and formalize AI-assisted development workflows for the team, and use them as the default way of working.

- Share the team's ad-hoc intake and on-call rotation, and take analysis and reporting requests outside modeling when the team needs it.

- Mentor the team on data modeling and SQL.

- 8+ years in analytics engineering, product analytics, or data engineering roles with substantial hands-on modeling experience.

- Expert SQL and production dbt: incremental models, tests, documentation, CI, and performance at Snowflake-scale event volume.

- Hands-on experience designing product event instrumentation (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Segment, or equivalent).

- Experience modeling data through a backend service or schema migration while keeping downstream reporting continuous.

- Semantic-layer modeling (Snowflake Semantic Views, LookML, dbt Semantic Layer, or similar).

- Demonstrated product and stakeholder sense: able to sit in a product sync, shape how a feature is measured before it is built, and explain tradeoffs to product managers and engineers.

- Comfortable picking up an unfamiliar business area — billing, eligibility, client reporting — and delivering without close direction.

- Git-based workflow, code review, and comfort reading application code to understand source data.

- Experience mentoring analysts or engineers.

description:
Natera is seeking a highly motivated Staff Machine Learning Scientist to join our rapidly growing company. As a member of the Data Science research team you will participate in the design and prototyping of cutting edge algorithms for analysis of genetic and clinical data. You will perform data analysis, algorithm design, contribute to our intellectual property portfolio, and interact closely with R&D and product teams to define the requirements and improve the products and processes. 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- ML/DL Research Leadership: Lead research on machine learning and deep learning models using NGS data. Frame the problem, choose the approach, and decide when a model has earned the next round of investment. This is an individual contributor role with Staff-level scope. You will set the technical direction of the work, not just carry out a plan someone else wrote. 

- Algorithm and Model Development: Design, build, and benchmark the models and features behind the next generation of Women Health and Organ Health products. Apply statistical learning and deep learning to high-dimensional, noisy, often small-sample sequencing data. Know when a simpler method is the right answer. 

- Working with Bioinformatics Pipelines: Work directly with the existing sequencing pipelines and their outputs without needing a bioinformatician to run, change, or interpret them for you. When results look wrong, trace the problem back through each processing step and work out whether it comes from the pipeline, the data, or the biology. Build or extend pipeline components when a project needs it.Â 

- Study Design and Experimental Partnership: Work with molecular biology and assay development scientists to design experiments. Help decide what data to generate, how much of it, and with what controls so the analysis can answer the question. Troubleshoot experiments alongside the lab, and tell a biology problem from a data or analysis problem. 

- Rigor and Documentation: Set the standard for careful analysis on the team: sound validation design, honest performance estimates, no leakage between training and evaluation data, and documentation. Support the group in producing high-quality technical and design documentation. 

- Intellectual Property and Scientific Contribution: Contribute to Natera's IP portfolio through invention disclosures and patent work, and to its scientific reputation through publications and presentations where appropriate. 

- Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Mentor data scientists and bioinformaticians, review their work, and be the person others bring hard modeling questions to. Make decisions about your own methods with minimal direction, including when the problem is ambiguous, and know when to escalate. 

- Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here, including coding agents for implementation, analysis, and review. You own what you ship, whatever produced it. We do not screen for prior experience with these tools, and we provide the tooling and the ramp time. 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

- M.S. or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Engineering, or similar. Equivalent depth built through work counts fully. 

- 6+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning and data analysis on biological or genomic data after your degree. We count relevant experience from the point your work became substantially independent, however you got there. 

- A demonstrated track record of models or algorithms you led that reached real use (a product, a production pipeline, or a decision someone relied on), not only a result. 

- We are hiring for depth in NGS, bioinformatics, and machine learning, and we will provide the domain ramp. 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: 

- Depth in next-generation sequencing data analysis: sequencing QC, alignment and quantification, normalization, and the artifacts that come with them. You should have the judgment to spot a wrong result before someone else does. 

- Working fluency with NGS bioinformatics pipelines. You can run them on your own, read their code and logs, follow a result back through each processing step, and diagnose failures or unexpected outputs. You can also build or modify pipeline components when needed. 

- Extensive practical experience with machine learning, deep learning, and statistics, including model validation and performance estimation on limited or imbalanced data. 

- Advanced Python, including open-source ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost) in a cloud environment. 

- Experience processing large datasets and working with a query language such as SQL. 

- A proven ability to apply mathematical and statistical principles to real estimation problems and turn them into practical solutions. 

- Familiarity with assay development and analysis pipelines for molecular or clinical biomarkers. 

- Clear communication of technical results to people who do not share your background, and a record of delivering complex projects with cross-functional teams. 

PREFFERED SKILLS:Â 

- Experience with RNA-seq, small RNA/miRNA. 

- Experience building probabilistic models for NGS and omics data. 

- Experience with diagnostic product development in a regulated or CLIA/CAP setting. 

- Experience with workflow orchestration (Nextflow, WDL, Snakemake) and containerization (Docker), enough to read, debug, and extend existing workflows. 

- AWS or GCP for large-scale ML training and inference. 

- Patents, peer-reviewed publications, or conference presentations. 

- A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where a small team has high impact.

description: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Not a full-time seat. Engagement: Ongoing 1099 contract. Milestone prices are set against a frozen spec. This is not a full-time seat. First package: A fixed-price flows-and-kit package, about three weeks. After that, $50–75/hr as each product grows. Location: SF Bay Area, hybrid, with in-person working sessions for kickoff and reviews. Start: Immediately after selection. Level: Mid-level welcome. You work directly with the founding CTO. Early sessions are for breaking the product down together. After that, scope is deliverable by deliverable. ABOUT THE STUDIO:
We are a small Bay Area product studio. Several products, one stack, one visual language. You own the UX with us: who the user is, what they are trying to finish, what belongs on each screen, and what happens when it fails. Later products reuse the same tokens, components, and patterns so customers and our engineers are not learning a new UI every time. The products are B2B web apps: dashboards, media and content libraries, status views, and auth and access-gate states. The first product in the queue is a digital signage CMS. Store owners upload content, build playlists, pair outdoor Android screens from a phone, and see what is playing. The app is a mobile-first PWA. The screen on the sidewalk has its own states: setup QR, downloading, no content, and error. You take a real part in that breakdown. Bring a point of view on structure, priority, and what to cut. Sit with us and map the flows before the high-fidelity screens exist. When a familiar admin layout is the wrong job for the task, say so and show the alternative. The screens still have to ship. We start from a Tailwind UI / shadcn component kit. Buttons, inputs, tables, cards, and dialogs stay that anatomy, restyled with our brand: color, type, radius, and density. Page structure, hierarchy, and flow are yours. Every screen is composed from those components, with tokens that map to our Tailwind theme, so the frontend team builds from the system. FOR MORE DETAILS OR TO APPLY: https://vuetech.sh/careers

Accelerate repeatable workflows

Structure and solve problems

Improve output quality

Increase speed and leverage

title: Product Analytics Team Lead
description:
HEY THERE 

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION 

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

- Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next

- Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on

- Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up

- Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it

- Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before

- Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool

- Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

YOUR PROFILE 

You'll feel at home here if:

- You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course

- You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself

- Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways

- You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through

- You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data

- When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

Bonus points for:

- Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)

- A strong statistics background

- Dagster or Airflow for scheduling

- Data catalogues like DataHub

OUR CORE TECH STACK 

Here's what we run in production:

- Warehouse: Snowflake

- Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster

- Experimentation: GrowthBook

- Self-service analytics: Omni

- ML workflows: Prefect

- GenAI: Claude

If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US? 

- An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

- A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

- 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

- A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

- A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

- A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

- Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

- A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION 

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US? 

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

- Your CV in English

- Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

title: Model Developer (Client Education)
description:
Hi 👋 I’m Dom Allgood, Client Education Manager at hyperexponential. I joined four years ago as a Curriculum Developer and have spent the last couple of years growing Client Education into the (soon to be) five-person team it is today. Before hx I spent a decade teaching Computing in secondary schools. Outside of work most of my time goes to my two children, and what's left to running and, more recently, mountain biking - where I'm still very much a beginner.

Client Education exists to get our customers to value as quickly as possible, and to keep them there. We run instructor-led training, own hx Academy where all our self-paced learning content lives, own the certification programme, and run some of our customer events. We've also recently taken ownership of Developer+, and that's where this role comes in. Our first customers are working through the programme now, and as it grows it will need to evolve based on what we learn from them.

This isn't a typical Delivery Engineer role, you'll sit in Client Education rather than Delivery Engineering. You'll still work closely with the wider Delivery Engineering team, but your day to day is the customers on Developer+: delivering workshops, running drop-ins, reviewing their code, and shaping the programme around what you learn doing it. You'll partner with Product too, so customers can adopt new enhancements quickly and smoothly. There's no established playbook for this yet, so what matters most is the drive to build one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to own, I'd love to hear from you.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes, like whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We’re already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Delivery Engineering team 

The hyperexponential Delivery Engineering team is a unique blend of engineers, actuaries, mathematicians and data scientists. We don’t take on traditional “transformations” (we have brilliant partners for that). We specialise in handling only the most difficult and interesting problems our customers face, where only a combination of technical depth, market expertise and hx knowledge will do.

The Delivery Engineering team are the experts' experts of the hx platform, knowing it top-to-bottom, inside-out – both breadth and depth. You’ll learn its limits and which can be pushed. You’ll uncover every trick in the book, the secret combinations, and the shortcuts. You’ll combine all of this with a growing knowledge of insurance technology to present 'the art of the possible' to our customers and help shape cutting-edge tech, while working alongside some of the brightest, most ambitious people in the tech and insurance industries.

What you'll be doing

- Move customer teams from hx-led build to independent delivery, shifting effort from pairing toward review and advisory.

- Keep every engagement moving to its prescribed path, sequencing services to each customer's build stage.

- Deliver structured enablement sessions; architecture, coding best practice, testing and deployment, model lifecycles.

- Run code review as a consistent, standards-anchored service, evolving hx's model development standards where reviews expose gaps.

- Provide drop-in support shaped by each customer's build stage, resolving most issues in session rather than escalating.

- Make Developer+ repeatable rather than personality-dependent, documenting delivery and using AI to scale capacity.

- Convert delivery knowledge into hx Academy content, prioritised by what reviews and drop-ins actually surface.

- Act as the technical voice of the customer into Product, feeding back recurring friction on a regular rhythm.

What you'll need to have done

- Shipped and maintained production-grade Python code in complex or data-heavy environments, including testing, deployment and model lifecycles.

- Have excellent pricing and modelling judgement when working with customer’s - working with insurance & actuarial teams is a plus.

- Developed strong technical enablement instincts, pitching sessions and documentation at the audience's real level.

- Coached customer teams to work independently rather than solving problems for them.

- Operated with high ownership and self-direction, building repeatable process where none exists.

- Prioritised transparently across competing delivery, review and content demands.

- Communicated with credibility and clarity across developers, actuaries, delivery partners and internal stakeholders.

How we build in an AI-forward company 

hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work.

We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible.

Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools.

The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life .

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

- Talent Team Interview

- Take-home Python challenge followed by Skills Interview

- Manager Interview 

- Values Interview

- Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.
